name: Drake Knight Armor
acquisition: Armor Set comprised of the Drake Knight Helm , Drake Knight Armor , Drake Knight Gauntlets and the Drake Knight Greaves . This set can be acquired once you reach the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Use the red roof below the grace to reach the rooftop garden-like area in the northeast which has a rotunda structure with a lift inside. The lift can't be used initially so drop down onto the large red roof to the south, then down the walkway to the east. Check along the northeast edge of this walkway for a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda building's lower balcony. The armor set can be found in a chest at the northeast end of this balcony.

In the hidden tunnels behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room at the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. After opening the secret passage behind the altar and taking the stairs down, after crossing the narrow fallen rafter, directly to the left is a tent and in the far corner you can find the full Nomadic Merchant's set. To get access to the set, you need to destroy tent by either aggroing the enemy close by, leading it next to the tent and baiting its frenzy attack onto it or quit-outing while standing very close to tent itself.

name: Tree Sentinel Armor
acquisition: Armor Set comprised of the Tree Sentinel Helm , Tree Sentinel Armor , Tree Sentinel Gauntlets and Tree Sentinel Greaves . Obtained inside the Auriza Hero's Grave by destroying three specific Chariots. Doing this involves a few steps: From this first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path and you will end up in a large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. These are the Chariots you need to destroy. Head down the hall all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you will find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way down onto the lowest beam you can drop down to and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Climb up the ladder to reach another Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Wait for the Chariot to head downwards and then run up the ramp and enter the chamber on the right where you will find a flamethrower pillar. Hit the pillar to raise it which will activate the circular golden seal in the middle of the large double Chariot Hall, teleporting the Chariot from the third hall and causing it to collide with the double Chariots. From here, you will need to return to the large hall to witness the collision event and collect your items. The easiest way to do this is by killing yourself or using the Memory of Grace tool (if you don't care about your runes) to return to the Site of Grace. Alternatively, from the flamethrower pillar room, return to the third Chariot Hall, go all the way down the ramp and turn left into a corridor. Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Armor Set along with the Ash of War: Holy Ground .

Take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar was raised. Wait for breaks between flame spews and head through the corridor in the north. There is an alcove on the right halfway through the corridor which you can use to safely wait for another break before heading towards the end. At the end of this corridor, you can turn left to return to the large Chariot Hall. After the Chariots crash into each other, you will receive the Ash of War along with the Tree Sentinel Armor Set .

acquisition: Head southeast of Moorth Ruins. From the Shattered Stone Talisman chest, drop down to the nearest platform and continue descending until you reach the ground where three Inquisitors are situated. Defeat them and enter the small building nearby to find this item inside a chest. IF YOU DIE GOING DOWN: you can enter this are from a descent slightly northeast from here.

name: Golden Lightning Fortification
acquisition: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab by the cliffs south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

name: Golden Vow
acquisition: At the end of the room, hanging from a body.

name: Great Heal
acquisition: Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

name: Greyoll's Roar
acquisition: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.

name: Gurranq's Beast Claw
acquisition: Bestial Sanctum : Reward from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman after giving him the eighth Deathroot .

name: Heal
acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

name: Heal from Afar
acquisition: This spell can be looted on the ground by the foot of an underground golden tree. It is located in a cave path to the base of the Rauh Ruins, north-northeast of the Moorth Ruins in Scadu Atlus. Guarded by 3 Perfumers

name: Honed Bolt
acquisition: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

name: Howl of Shabriri
acquisition: Incantation . Found in a chest on the second level of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower .

name: Immutable Shield
acquisition: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

name: Inescapable Frenzy
acquisition: After making your way past Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and defeating Mohg, the Omen , attack the altar at the front of the boss room. It should lower revealing a new area. Continue through here until you are forced to parkour downwards using stone coffins as platforms. Near the bottom you will see a corpse that has Inescapable Frenzy on it.

name: Knight's Lightning Spear
acquisition: Incantation found in Scorpion River Catacombs. When you enter the area with two spiked ceilings and a run across a bridge under the gaze of a deadly basilisk. Cross the bridge towards the next lift, and stop at the end, then jump on the ledge to the left and follow it up towards the basilisk. You will see this item in a room guarded by two Lion Imps right behind the Basilisk statue

name: Lansseax's Glaive
acquisition: Incantation that channels the powr of the ancient dragon Lansseax.

name: Law of Causality
acquisition: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

name: Law of Regression
acquisition: Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.

name: Lightning Fortification
acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

name: Lightning Spear
acquisition: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point ofimpact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.

name: Lightning Strike
acquisition: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the lower section of the crevasse. When approaching from either the eastern or western cliffs, look for stone platforms jutting out of the cliffside to safely descend to the area. Beware as the area is constantly being pummeled by lightning and there are several Giant bats guarding the scarab as well.

name: Litany of Proper Death
acquisition: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

name: Lord's Aid
acquisition: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished

name: Lord's Divine Fortification
acquisition: Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two

name: Lord's Heal
acquisition: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished

name: Magic Fortification
acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.

name: Magma Breath
acquisition: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

name: Minor Erdtree (spell)
acquisition: Located at the Shaman Village in the Scaduview region. The spell can be found in the field of flowers.

name: Multilayered Ring of Light
acquisition: Drops from the Misbegotten Crusader in Stone Coffin Fissure.

name: Noble Presence
acquisition: Incantation. Dropped by Godskin Noble

name: O, Flame!
acquisition: Incantation of the Fire Monks.

name: Order Healing
acquisition: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the middle of a circular section of the Siofra Aqueduct .

name: Order's Blade
acquisition: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death. Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived. The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.

name: Pest-Thread Spears
acquisition: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the elevator to reach the upper level. Still within the scarlet rot swamp area, head to either side of them before going up the stairs, and at the back you'll find this incantation guarded by a couple of Kindred of Rot

name: Pest Threads
acquisition: Incantation of the servants of rot.

name: Placidusax's Ruin
acquisition: Power gleaned form the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.

name: Poison Armament
acquisition: Incantation . Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the northeast section of Aeonia Swamp. Figure out its pattern via the footprints and wait for the prints to approach and then attack.

name: Poison Mist
acquisition: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the forested area.

name: Protection of the Erdtree
acquisition: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab . It can be found on top of the stone ruin.

name: Radagon's Rings of Light
acquisition: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

name: Rain of Fire
acquisition: From the West Rampart Site of Grace, take the bridge all the way. Use Torrent to avoid being trappped in the Rain of Fire. Defeat the Fire Knight at the end to obtain this and Salza's Hood .

name: Rejection
acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

name: Roar of Rugalea
acquisition: Dropped by Rugalea the Great Red Bear, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace, in the wooded area where there are many large bears.

name: Rotten Breath
acquisition: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

name: Scarlet Aeonia
acquisition: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.

name: Scouring Black Flame
acquisition: Incantation, dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .

name: Shadow Bait
acquisition: Can be found on a corpse at Subterranean Shunning-Grounds , after going through the pipe room to a room with the corpse sitting at the center, next to a not very well hidden Ogre ready to strike.

name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
acquisition: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion.

name: Spira
acquisition: Enir-Illim: Found on small altar that is directly in front of statue, accessed by walking on the tree branches leading to this small broken-off platform

name: Stone of Gurranq
acquisition: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.

name: Surge, O Flame!
acquisition: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.

acquisition: Incantation . Found on a corpse by one of the pillars on the left side of the Callu Baptismal Church .

name: Theodorix's Magma
acquisition: Unlocked after the defeat of Great Wyrm Theodorix . This item can then be purchased after its defeat.

name: Triple Rings of Light
acquisition: Incantation . Found in a chest locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. Requires 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock.

name: Unendurable Frenzy
acquisition: Incantation . Found in a chest in an underground treasure room in the central section of the Yelough Anix Ruins .

name: Urgent Heal
acquisition: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.

name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
acquisition: Dragon Cult Incantation . Received after defeating Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable at Lord Contender's Evergaol .

name: Watchful Spirit
acquisition: Incantation given by Hornsent Grandam if you talk to hear while wearing the Divine Beast Head. Talk to her a few times until she gives the item.

name: Whirl, O Flame!
acquisition: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon.

As soon as you can turn right. Beware of the bat hanging from the ceiling. Reach the other side, and take the ladder up. Turn left and move towards the area in which there is a giant gear (the one that does not have a bat on it), once you are aligned fall down to find the spell behind the column.

name: Wrath of Gold
acquisition: Found at Woodfolk Ruins . Among the enemies, there is a staircase that goes down and leads to a chest that contains this Incantation

acquisition: Key used to unlock the gate of Raya Lucaria Academy

name: Academy Scroll
acquisition: Key Item. Give to a mage to unlock more sorceries. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising.

name: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
acquisition: Incantation Tome. Found at ground level in the middle of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

acquisition: Located in the area where you find Devonia, Crucible Knight.

name: Assassin's Prayerbook
acquisition: Prayerbook of the Roundtable Hold's assassins.

name: Beast Eye
acquisition: Claw-marked stone eye received from Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.

name: Black Knifeprint
acquisition: Black Knifeprint is a Key Item needed to advance in Sorcerer Rogier's questline. Dropped by Black Knife Assassin upon defeat.

acquisition: Quest Item. Given by Ranni after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade .

name: Celestial Dew

name: Conspectus Scroll
acquisition: Looted off a body inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. You'll see the corpse in front a an illusory wall.

name: Cracked Pot
acquisition: Crafting Pot. Found on the cliffs overlooking the gardens below.

name: Crafting Kit
acquisition: Leather bag containing a pestle and mortar, small blade, and various other tools. Enables item crafting from the main menu. Provides both means to fight and means to survive.

name: Cursemark of Death
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

acquisition: Key Item. Given by Patches in Shaded Castle , before the boss room, after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to him in Volcano Manor .

acquisition: Inside Deathtouched Catacombs. Found on a chest behind the Black Knife Assassin.

acquisition: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth , accessible via ladder past all the bats on the bottom level.

name: Discarded Palace Key
acquisition: A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh. Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses. It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

name: Dragon Cult Prayerbook
acquisition: Dropped by a knight patrolling immediately south of the Liurnia Artist Shack

name: Dragon Heart
acquisition: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .

name: Fingerprint Grape
acquisition: Dropped by Festering Fingerprint Vyke .

name: Fingerslayer Blade
acquisition: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground

name: Fire Monks' Prayerbook
acquisition: Incantation Tome. Found on a corpse in an enemy outpost in the area.

name: Gaol Lower Level Key
acquisition: Lamenter's Gaol. Can be found on a chest in an area full of Living Jar enemies.

name: Gaol Upper Level Key
acquisition: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. When you enter, proceed until you reach a fork in the path. Take the left turn, and after a short walk, enter the room on your right. Inside, you'll find a chest containing the Gaol Upper Level Key.

name: Giant's Prayerbook
acquisition: Key Item. Give to a Cleric to unlock Incantations: Giantsflame Take Thee and Flame, Fall Upon Them for purchase.

name: Godskin Prayerbook
acquisition: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , Nearest Site of Grace: Rampart Tower. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, go out the door to the outside (where the birds are). Take a running jump onto the roof across from the door. On the left side of the roof, there will be two separate areas you can drop down to. Drop down to the one without stairs on it, and drop down again. You'll land by a set of steps going down. Go down the steps to find some rats and a white fog wall. You'll need a Stonesword Key to pass through the fog wall, and inside will be two chests. One contains the Godskin Prayerbook, the other contains the Godslayer's Seal . Alternatively, from the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace, exit from the door to the courtyard and turn right. Hug the right side wall past all the enemies. You'll find the set of stairs going down on the wall on the other side.

name: Gold Sewing Needle
acquisition: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

name: Golden Order Principia
acquisition: Incantation Tome. From the Erdtree Sanctuary site in Leyndell, Royal Capital, exit the east side of the room. Once outside, climb up the root to the left that circles back into the building's 2nd floor. Once inside, exit the only door and immediately turn left to jump down to a nearby roof. Once on the roof, a broken window can be used to get back inside. After entering the broken window, climb the root crossing the room to reach the Golden Order Principia, which is located in the chair hanging from the ceiling.

name: Golden Tailoring Tools
acquisition: Tools made of gold brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

name: Heart of Bayle
acquisition: Dropped by Bayle the Dread upon defeat.

name: Hefty Cracked Pot
acquisition: Special Tool Key Item. From the location of the Ghost NPC, south of the Scorched Ruins. Head north and take the first right to the higher ground. Alongside a group of Shadows, you will find a body containing this item.

name: Hole-Laden Necklace
acquisition: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

name: Igon's Furled Finger
acquisition: Will be given by Igon by interacting with him after defeating the Jagged Peak Drake in the area.

name: Imbued Sword Key
acquisition: The Imbued Sword Key item can be found inside a treasure chest. The chest is located inside a tower's armor room.

name: Letter for Freyja
acquisition: Given by Sir Ansbach after handing over the Secret Rite Scroll.

name: Lord of Blood's Favor
acquisition: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

name: Lord of Blood's Favor (Soaked)
acquisition: Key Item. Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading other players 3 times and talking to him, then accepting to be knighted.

name: Lost Ashes of War
acquisition: A Lost Ashes of War can be found in the middle of the Ellac Greatbridge.

name: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
acquisition: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax

name: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
Messmer's Kindling
acquisition: Key Item Dropped by Messmer the Impaler

name: Miniature Ranni
acquisition: Key Item. Found in an open stone coffin in the waters of Ainsel River Main .

name: Monk's Missive
acquisition: Looted off the ground just behind where Hornsent is standing. You'll also acquire the May the Best Win gesture alongside this key item.

name: Perfume Bottle
acquisition: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

name: Prayer Room Key
acquisition: Acquired as a drop upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign for the second time.

name: Ritual Pot
acquisition: Special Tool Key Item. Found on a corpse in the northern section of the Laskyar Ruins , in front of a set of pillars.

name: Rold Medallion
acquisition: Given by Melina at the Site of Grace once you defeat Morgott, The Omen King .

name: Royal House Scroll
acquisition: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

name: Ruins Map
acquisition: Given by Ymir when first interacted.

name: Ruins Map (2nd)
acquisition: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

name: Ruins Map (3rd)
acquisition: Given by Ymir after completing her questline.

name: Secret Rite Scroll
acquisition: Located on a table inside the room down the stairs, after progressing outside from the fourth floor. It's near the edge of this area.

name: Seedbed Curse
acquisition: Key Item. Found after you exit the room with East Capital Rampart grace, continue south past the Oracle Envoys and into the building. Inside, head down the stairs and face west to take the elevator. After the elevator continue west into the next building. Climb up the ladder to your right and go up the stairs. On the highest floor you will find the Seedbed Curse on a corpse sitting in a chair.

name: Seluvis's Introduction
acquisition: A scroll given by Seluvis . It is addressed to Sorceress Sellen

name: Seluvis's Potion
acquisition: Key Quest Item. Given by Seluvis after accepting his task.

name: Serpent's Amnion
acquisition: Found on the altar after defeating the Godskin Noble Boss in Volcano Manor .

acquisition: Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

name: Sewing Needle
acquisition: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.

name: Spirit Calling Bell
acquisition: Key Item. Given by Renna . Return to the church after getting your horse to find her sitting by the ruins.

name: Storehouse Cross Message
acquisition: Climb the feet of the statue and move towards the head, jump to the next area. You will find the item on a table, next to a Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace

name: Storeroom Key
acquisition: From the top of the waterfall, you will find a room with a ladder, enter the room and climb the ladder. At the top, you will find a corpse with the Storeroom Key.

name: Tailoring Tools
acquisition: Key Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat.

name: Talisman Pouch
acquisition: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Dropped by Margit, the Fell Omen upon defeat.

name: Two Fingers' Prayerbook
acquisition: Located in the first floor of Fortified Manor.

name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
acquisition: Key Quest Item. Required to progress Gowry 's questline. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

name: Valkyrie's Prosthesis
acquisition: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight .

name: Weathered Dagger
acquisition: Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.

name: Well Depths Key
acquisition: From the Whiteflesh Mushroom found on the bridge, enter the room with two enemies and you will find the Well Depths Key there.

name: Whetstone Knife
acquisition: Key Item. Found in the southeastern area of Gatefront Ruins . There is a set of stairs that leads to a small room with a treasure chest. This item is found alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp upgrade.

acquisition: Key item used for Rebirth. Obtained by defeating a regular Noble enemy, that transforms into a Lesser Rune Bear. If you kill the Bear form a larval tear will drop.

name: Larval Tear #2
acquisition: Larval Tear dropped by a Troll disguised as a regular enemy.

acquisition: The Map Fragment for Scadu Altus can be looted next to a monolith. When you pass the Highroad Cross Site of Grace through Castle Ensis, simply follow the road northeast.

acquisition: Map for all of Weeping Peninsula .

acquisition: Memory Upgrade Material. Found in a chest on the top floor of the Converted Tower .

name: Memory Stone #4
acquisition: Rewarded as a drop upon defeating Red Wolf of Radagon .

name: Memory Stone #5
acquisition: Memory Slot Upgrade Material. Found in a chest at the top floor of Testu's Rise .

acquisition: Dropped by the Elden Beast upon defeat.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #1
acquisition: Can be found on a body hanging on the chandelier next to the Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #2
acquisition: When you reach the Library, jump on the bookshelves and make your way to the other side where you see a large enemy. Defeat it to acquire a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #3
acquisition: On a small altar. North-east of the Gravesite plain site of grace. Past the white tree filled with hanging bodies.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #4
acquisition: Found at an altar located to the east of the Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace. In the vicinity of the pond inhabited by small turtles.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #5
acquisition: Can be found on an altar in the Ellac River Cave near the Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #6
acquisition: 2 Revered Spirit Ash can be found on the alter in the middle of the room infested by Spider-Scorpions.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #7
acquisition: Can be found on the altar in the Village of Flies. Accessible only from Reclusive River Downstream area

name: Revered Spirit Ash #8
acquisition: Climb up after defeating the two Gravebirds and you will spot a Shadow Pothead enemy. Grants 735 Runes upon defeat. Drops x1 Revered Spirit Ash and x1 Golden Horn Tender.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #9
acquisition: After crossing the bridge with the Horned Warrior, turn left to enter an open area with a tree in the center and numerous enemies in prayer. You'll find the Revered Spirit Ash on an altar across from the tree.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #10
acquisition: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, head to the right side of the arena to find a lift. Take the lift up and proceed forward to open a large door. Once through, you will find the altar nearby that has a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #11
acquisition: x1 Revered Spirit Ash can be looted on a broken Revered Statue at the Abandoned Ailing Village. The statue is guarded by Man-Fly enemies.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #12
acquisition: Outside the First Rise Site of Grace, take the stairs up and cross the bridge to a large enemy. Defeat the enemy to acquire a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #13
acquisition: In an indoor Altar like room with Man-Fly(s) praying to an idol sculpture. The x2 Revered Spirit Ash will be at the base of the statue.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #14
acquisition: Found East from Moorth Ruins, on a statue by the cliff overlooking Bonny Village. Beware of a Deathblade nearby.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #15
acquisition: In Bonny Village: Fall down from the broken bridge, and follow the path north, past the dog, you will find a statue containing the revered spirit ash at the end of the road.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #16
acquisition: Can be found within a small room on an altar. Be wary of Gravebird enemies in the area.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #17
acquisition: South of Temple Town Ruins, you will see the altar near the edge.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #18
acquisition: Found on the statue in the middle. Beware of enemies in the area.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #19
acquisition: Found on the altar by the stone wall southeast from Ruins of Unte

name: Revered Spirit Ash #20
acquisition: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead found above the lift near the scorpions and poison flower in Ancient Ruins of Rauh, along with x1 Silver Horn Tender, x1 Dewgem, and x1 Rauh Burrow.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #21
acquisition: Dropped by a Shadowpot Enemy in the ruins west of the Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #22
acquisition: Climb up the statue's feet and carefully drop down the beast statue below, where you'll find a Revered Spirit Ash.

name: Revered Spirit Ash #23
acquisition: From the Seventh Floor Site of Grace, head to the opposite side, and jump on the railings on the left side and you will find this item on the hanging statue.

name: Scadutree Fragment #5

name: Scadutree Fragment #6
acquisition: Item drops from a pot-bearing Shadow enemy. Grants 707 Runes upon defeat. Drops x1 Scadutree Fragment and x1 Silver Horn Tender. In a gravesite area, southwest of Cliffroad Terminus Site of Grace. Surrounded by other shadow enemies and a dog.

name: Scadutree Fragment #7
acquisition: 2 Scadutree Fragments can be found at the Church of Consolation's by the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #8
acquisition: x2 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of the altar inside the Abandoned Church.

name: Scadutree Fragment #9
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment is dropped by a pot-bearing Shadow enemy that sparkles and runs away. Kill it quickly to get the drop.

name: Scadutree Fragment #10
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by the Miquella's Cross of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #11
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace near NPCs Sir Ansbach and Moore.

name: Scadutree Fragment #12
acquisition: From the Abyssal Woods Site of Grace, head north to find a corpse sitting against a tree. Loot the dead body to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #13
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground beside Miquella's Cross of the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #14
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Scaduview Cross Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #15
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found on the altar near the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #16
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found next to the statue of Marika, located at a Messmer Soldier encampment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #17
acquisition: Upon reaching a large room on the northwest side with the 2 large Spider Scorpions in it and the Bone Bow , jump over the rubble on the right side just before the doorway to this room. There's another doorway just behind the rubble, and following the path beyond will lead to a small room with the fragment, next to a Miquella's Cross

name: Scadutree Fragment #18
acquisition: From the First Rise Site of Grace of Enir-Ilim, progress the area until you're about to reach the Spiral Rise Site of Grace. Near the checkpoint, you'll find a stairway that leads down to a room where you can loot the Inquisitor Ashes. Outside of this room, jump down onto a broken staircase that might look like a dead-end. Check the east side of this staircase to drop onto the narrow edge of the wall. Wrap along the side of it until you reach a platform that has a body holding x10 Golem's Great Arrow. Look south and do a running jump to jump across the pit and towards a window. Drop down to formally arrive in a secret section of Belurat Tower Settlement. Continue forward from here until you find a covered statue where you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment by the foot of the statue.

name: Scadutree Fragment #19
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.

name: Scadutree Fragment #20
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment drops from one of the two Hippopotamus enemies in the area. This area can only be accessed by using the ladder in Shadow Keep to get down to a special teleport coffin. This will take you to Ruins of Unte and you must follow the cliffs downstream, and then carefully drop down to the bottom level to reach it.

name: Scadutree Fragment #21
acquisition: BEWARE of a Deathblade nearby. South of Moorth Ruins, you'll find a pot-bearing Shadow towards the giant fissure at the center of the location. Instead of dropping down, wrap around the south side of the fissure to find the enemy. Kill the pot-bearing Shadow enemy to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #22
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found beside Miquella's Cross of the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #23
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Spiral Rise Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #24
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #25
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #26
acquisition: Location: Outer Tower of Enir-Ilim. After picking up the previous Revered Spirit Ash, continue heading up the stairs and you'll find a room with an altar where x1 Scadutree Fragment can be picked up.

name: Scadutree Fragment #27
acquisition: Northwest of the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace, there is a Messmer Soldiers encampment. x1 Scadutree Fragment can looted by the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #28
acquisition: Temple Town Ruins . From the entrance through the gap in the wall, take the stairs on the right and climb up until you reach the cloth-like part of the structure at the top. Before heading down, check on the right side to see a small opening that will lead to the middle platform. Fall there and defeat the two enemies, In the middle of the bridge you will find a body that has x1 Scadutree Fragment.

name: Scadutree Fragment #29
acquisition: Head north from Moorth Ruins to find an area with a pond and a cave entrance that leads to Rauh Ruins. Cross the pond, and just before the entrance to the cave, you'll find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted by the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #30
acquisition: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace, head towards the building and climb up the stairs. Beware of the enemies in this room. Reach the end to find x1 Scadutree Fragment in front of the large altar.

name: Scadutree Fragment #31
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment found in a coffin at the bottom of the waterfall. To reach this area, you must follow the cliffs along the top and then find a place to drop by a graveyard with gravebirds, then explore upriver.

name: Scadutree Fragment #32
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the statue of Marika located at the Messmer Soldiers encampment. If you aggroed the Furnace Golem in this area, chances are the creature can destroy the statue. But you can still find the Scadutree Fragment there.

name: Scadutree Fragment #33
acquisition: x2 Scadutree Fragment can looted off the ground. The item is found inside the Church of the Crusade, just by the foot of the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #34
acquisition: Defeat the Lesser Golden Hippopotamus to obtain the fragment. The enemy drops 11960 Runes and x1 Scadutree Fragment .

name: Scadutree Fragment #35
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

name: Scadutree Fragment #36
acquisition: Obtain x2 Scadutree Fragment after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .

name: Scadutree Fragment #37
acquisition: Past the Spider-Scorpions after entering the tunnel, move forward, and turn right. Locate the Shadowpot Enemy and kill it to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment .

name: Scadutree Fragment #38
acquisition: Located at the Church District of the Shadow Keep . x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted on the hand of the statue of Marika. Time your jump to grab it. NOTE: Drain the water so you can jump onto the statue's hand.

name: Scadutree Fragment #39
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace in the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep.

name: Scadutree Fragment #40
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted in front of a small statue of Marika, located in the Dark Chamber entrance of the Shadow Keep's Specimen Storehouse.

name: Scadutree Fragment #41
acquisition: From the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, enter the room to your right to find x1 Scadutree Fragment that can be looted on the ground, by the foot of the statue of Marika.

name: Scadutree Fragment #42
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #44
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #45
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Scadutree Fragment #46
acquisition: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by the roots in front of the chalice.

name: Albinauric Shield
acquisition: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

name: Ant's Skull Plate
acquisition: Greatshield . Found in a chest in a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Banished Knight's Shield
acquisition: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
acquisition: A large shield kept inside a chest at a camp.

name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
acquisition: Found in the room next to the site of the grace.

name: Black Leather Shield
acquisition: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

name: Black Steel Greatshield
acquisition: This shield item drops as a reward upon defeating the boss Black Knight Garrew .

name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.

name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
acquisition: A standard medium-sized shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foreground against a blue sky.

name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
acquisition: Shield in Academy Gate Town (near Raya Lucaria Academy Entrance). Can be found on the outskirts of the buildings, towards the west side.

name: Brass Shield
acquisition: Found southeast of the map in Limgrave. Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Defeat it to obtain a Brass Shield.

name: Briar Greatshield
acquisition: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

name: Buckler
acquisition: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center enables parrying techniques. A well-timed parry can break an enemy's stance, allowing a critical hit. Best suited for those prepared to take the risk to reap their reward.

name: Candletree Wooden Shield
acquisition: In the Sage's Cave , in a chest behind an illusory wall.

name: Carian Knight's Shield
acquisition: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight .

name: Carian Thrusting Shield
acquisition: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. Past the Storehouse site of grace, continue forward you will reach a room where you find a Fire Knight and a few other enemies. The item is right past the Fire Knight and can be found on a corpse under the table.

name: Coil Shield
acquisition: Located on a body in Volcano Cave, northeast of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir. You will need to drop down a hole and then double back.

name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
acquisition: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel

name: Crucible Hornshield
acquisition: Shield. Dropped by the Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges of the Siofra Aqueduct .

name: Cuckoo Greatshield
acquisition: Metal Greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. Our Enemys is none other then caria itself

name: Distinguished Greatshield
acquisition: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

name: Dragon Towershield
acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a chest in the terrace section of a building far to the bottom of the plaza southeast from the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. This building can be reached by dropping down a series of cliffs east of the plaza until you see the archway leading into the building. Follow the linear path from here to a lower balcony with a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the terrace and look to the east to find the chest by the railings.

name: Dragonclaw Shield
acquisition: Greatshield that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel guarding the path into the capital.

name: Dueling Shield
acquisition: From the middle area, take the set of stairs to the next floor. Move to the eastern side, climb the wooden platform, and fight the Vulgar Militiamen. Use the stone platforms to reach the other side, the item is against the wall.

name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
acquisition: Drops from Mausoleum Knights wielding it in Liurnia of the Lakes (chance to drop, not guaranteed)

name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
acquisition: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree

name: Erdtree Greatshield
acquisition: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo

name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
acquisition: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your way down to the area. NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.

name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
acquisition: You can loot the Flame Crest Wooden Shield from a naked commoner's corpse inside one of the cabins.

name: Gilded Greatshield
acquisition: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

name: Gilded Iron Shield
acquisition: Shield. Found on a corpse sitting on a grave in the graveyard.

name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
acquisition: Greatshield. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

name: Golden Greatshield
acquisition: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

name: Golden Lion Shield
acquisition: Given by Redmane Freyja after you hand her over the Letter for Freyja.

name: Great Turtle Shell
acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse atop the eastern-most tower of the Castle Morne Ramparts. This area can be reached by using Torrent to jump from the Spiritspring located just east of the Site of Grace nearby.

name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
acquisition: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
acquisition: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Heater Shield
acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
acquisition: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

name: Ice Crest Shield
acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse up on a ledge by a jagged stone pillar. This area is in the gardens, jumping up on the rocks from the Teardrop Scarab nearby.

name: Icon Shield
acquisition: Found inside a crumbling building. Beware of the enemies inside.

name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
acquisition: Southwest of Siofra River Bank site, up a hill and past 3 enemies on a body.

name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
acquisition: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Iron Roundshield
acquisition: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Finely balanced, this shield is easy to use.

name: Jellyfish Shield
acquisition: On a dead body surrounded by four Jellyfish directly north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.

name: Kite Shield
acquisition: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

name: Large Leather Shield
acquisition: A round shield covered in leather. One of the larger categories of medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle wider range of attack affinities.

name: Lordsworn's Shield
acquisition: Wooden tower shield. Lightweightfor a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

name: Man-Serpent's Shield
acquisition: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir. Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

name: Manor Towershield
acquisition: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners . You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.

name: Marred Leather Shield
acquisition: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

name: Marred Wooden Shield
acquisition: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks . Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

name: One-Eyed Shield
acquisition: Shield. Dropped by mini-boss NPC Chief Guardian Arghanthy inside Guardian's Garrison .

name: Perfumer's Shield
acquisition: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

name: Pillory Shield
acquisition: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave .

name: Red Crest Heater Shield
acquisition: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.

name: Red Thorn Roundshield
acquisition: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to use, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient red thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.

name: Redmane Greatshield
acquisition: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

name: Rickety Shield
acquisition: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines or some such. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

name: Rift Shield
acquisition: Small metal roundshiled depicting a sinister rift. An antiquated charm that glares back at an enemy, it boosts focus.

name: Riveted Wooden Shield
acquisition: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design riveted to the center represents both sword and tree.

name: Round Shield
acquisition: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.

name: Scorpion Kite Shield
acquisition: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.

name: Scripture Wooden Shield
acquisition: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving linesd the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

name: Serpent Crest Shield
acquisition: Obtained by completing the "Incursion" Painting Puzzle.

name: Shield of Night
acquisition: Shield of Night is a new small shield that can be found in Bonny Gaol . The top level of this gaol can be accessed after using the jar lift near the bridge twice. You need to jump off at the bridge level, activate the switch, and then ride the jar going up. You will find this on the ledge behind the corpse on top of a table.

name: Shield of the Guilty
acquisition: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins , before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

name: Silver Mirrorshield
acquisition: Shield found in the Apostate Derelict church.

name: Smithscript Shield
acquisition: Jump from the opening left to the Lever, and instead of heading forward turn left. There are two Smithing Golems there, one that uses fire. Once defeated, stick to the right and go up to the upper platform using the crumbled column. You will find the item at the end of the hallway. Beware of the fire blob that falls from the ceiling.

name: Smoldering Shield
acquisition: Small Shield. Found on a corpse on the sitting by some tombstones on the same level as the lava in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Spiked Palisade Shield
acquisition: On dead body under a Golem, west of Deep Siofra Well, Caelid

name: Spiralhorn Shield
acquisition: Found a corpse near Mausoleum Compound. NW of Ruined Labyrinth Site of grace.

name: Sun Realm Shield
acquisition: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

name: Twinbird Kite Shield
acquisition: Medium Shield dropped by nighttime spawn Deathbird near Leyndell's Hermit Merchant's Shack.

name: Verdigris Greatshield
acquisition: Can be looted from Moore's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

name: Visage Shield
acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a chest in a small room behind the Mad Pumpkin Head duo bosses. Accessible after defeating them.

name: Wolf Crest Shield
acquisition: Located inside a storeroom you'll find a treasure chest that has the Wolf Crest Shield. The storeroom is found by following the staircase down instead of heading into the chapel to fight Moonrythil

name: Wooden Greatshield
acquisition: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

name: Adula's Moonblade
acquisition: Dropped by the Glintstone Dragon Adula in the Cathedral of Manus Celes .

name: Ambush Shard
acquisition: Weeping Peninsula : Found on a corpse in the underground jail of the Witchbane Ruins .

name: Ancient Death Rancor
acquisition: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Liurnia of the Lake , to the east of Raya Lucaria Academy at night, south of the Gate Town North site of grace.

name: Briars of Punishment
acquisition: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

name: Briars of Sin
acquisition: Liurnia of the Lakes : Dropped by a mob directly north-west from the Artists Shack. Jump across the rocks and they'll be by a group of fire slugs.

name: Cannon of Haima
acquisition: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

name: Carian Greatsword
acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family. Conjures a magic greatsword and then delivers a sweeping blow. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly. Armed with this spell, sorcerers gain the strength of knights, their loyalty sworn to the moon.

name: Carian Phalanx
acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Carian Piercer
acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the gardens near the east.

name: Carian Retaliation
acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Carian Slicer
acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Cherishing Fingers
acquisition: It can be picked up in the graveyard to the west of the Chathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline in full.

name: Collapsing Stars
acquisition: Gravity Sorcery . Looted from a chest inside the War-Dead Catacombs . In the main chamber with 4 staircases, drop into the lower level from the left side to find the chest amongst the ghostly knights fighting each other.

name: Comet
acquisition: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.

name: Comet Azur
acquisition: Sorcery . Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Azur .

name: Crystal Barrage
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Crystal Burst
acquisition: Drops from the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins

name: Crystal Release
acquisition: Sorcery Spell . Dropped by the Crystalians duo bosses inside the Academy Crystal Cave upon their defeat.

name: Crystal Torrent
acquisition: Dropped by Crystalians Trio boss in Sellia Hideaway

name: Eternal Darkness
acquisition: Night Sorcery . Found in a jail cell inside the Swamp Lookout Tower .

name: Explosive Ghostflame
acquisition: Drops from a Death Rite Bird southeast Apostate Derelict (late game area). It's a clearing in the frozen river, and you must go there at night.

name: Fia's Mist
acquisition: Obtained by defeating Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths . After unlocking the Across the Roots Grace, head north and defeat the boss.

name: Founding Rain of Stars
acquisition: Glinstone Sorcery. Found inside a chest at the top of Heretical Rise . You must access the tower by crossing an invisible bridge from the other side of the ravine.

name: Freezing Mist
acquisition: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

name: Frozen Armament
acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in an area behind Caria Manor. This area is accessible after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

name: Gavel of Haima
acquisition: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

name: Gelmir's Fury
acquisition: Glintstone Sorcery . Given by Resucant Bernahl after completing three contracts for Tanith at Volcano Manor .

name: Glintblade Phalanx
acquisition: One of the sorceries of the Carian royal family.

name: Glintblade Trio
acquisition: The Glintblade Trio spell is found by looting it off a corpse. After passing through the iron gate just beyond the chapel in the midpoint of the castle, then dropping off the side of the bridge and climbing up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. You can then drop down on the north side of the roof to get to the corpse hanging over a ledge that has the spell.

name: Glintstone Arc
acquisition: Fires a horizontal arc of magic that spreads outward. This sorcery can be cast repeteadly and while in motion.

name: Glintstone Cometshard
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires a magical comet with a trailing tail. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos Conspectus, the most venerable of the academy.

name: Glintstone Icecrag
acquisition: Sorcery said to have been used by the old snow witch.

name: Glintstone Pebble
acquisition: The most basic glintstone sorcery of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Glintstone Stars
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Gravitational Missile
acquisition: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast .

name: Gravity Well
acquisition: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy .

name: Great Glintstone Shard
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching large magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

name: Great Oracular Bubble
acquisition: Sorcery . Obtained by defeating the Teardrop Beetle found inside the large stone ruin at the highest level of the Siofra River .

name: Greatblade Phalanx
acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by Bols, Carian Knight inside the Cuckoo's Evergaol .

name: Impenetrable Thorns (spell)
acquisition: In Shadow Keep from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, cross the center of the storeroom after pulling the lever to rotate the center beams. Once outside, carefully walk off the ledge (you'll see a bat below). You'll find the spell on a corpse

name: Loretta's Greatbow
acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by Royal Knight Loretta upon defeat.

name: Loretta's Mastery
acquisition: Sorcery. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree

name: Lucidity
acquisition: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .

name: Magic Downpour
acquisition: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.

name: Magic Glintblade
acquisition: An old sorcery of the Carian Royal Family.

name: Magma Shot
acquisition: Sorcery . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the first letter quest.

name: Mantle of Thorns
acquisition: This item drops from the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that emerges beneath the ground, near the large tree.

name: Mass of Putrescence
acquisition: From the Fissure Waypoint site of grace, head northeast. Just after hopping over the little gap, drop down on the left (north) side and make your way north where you'll find the spell on a corpse.

name: Meteorite
acquisition: Sorcery . Dropped by the Alabaster Lord upon defeat.

name: Meteorite of Astel
acquisition: Gravity Sorcery. Dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness , the boss of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

name: Night Comet
acquisition: Night Sorcery spell. Found in a chest in the central section of town. This location is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

name: Night Maiden's Mist
acquisition: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

name: Night Shard
acquisition: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

name: Oracle Bubbles
acquisition: Can be found by killing one of the Teardrop Scarab on top of a broken statue in the first structure on the right from the Siofra River Deep Wells site of grace. You have to go through some ruins and jump on top of them and follow them over to another side where there is a Teardrop Scarab down below. Kill he Scarab to get this spell

name: Rancorcall
acquisition: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab that can be found at the underground crypt of the castle

name: Ranni's Dark Moon
acquisition: Sorcery Spell. Found in a chest at the top of Chelona's Rise after unlocking the tower's seal.

name: Rennala's Full Moon
acquisition: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.

name: Rings of Spectral Light
acquisition: Looted from the altar by the giant bird statue after defeating several birds

name: Rock Blaster
acquisition: Glintstone Sorcery . Found inside the Sellia Crystal Tunnel , in a chest inside a shed at the top level of the main cavern.

name: Rock Sling
acquisition: Gravity Sorcery . Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins .

name: Roiling Magma
acquisition: Sorcery . Found on a corpse inside the Hermit's Shack .

name: Rykard's Rancor
acquisition: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

name: Scholar's Armament
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Scholar's Shield
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Shard Spiral
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Shatter Earth
acquisition: Sorcery. Found on a corpse in the second-to-last level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel . Inside an opening in the north.

name: Shattering Crystal
acquisition: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

name: Star Shower
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.

name: Starlight
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

name: Stars of Ruin
acquisition: Given by Master Lusat when interacted with inside the Sellia Hideaway behind an arcane ward in the second pit. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker to get through arcane ward (Acquired during Sorceress Sellen Questline).

name: Swift Glintstone Shard
acquisition: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.

name: Terra Magica
acquisition: Sorcery . Found at the top of a tower in the middle of the Raya Lucaria Academy. This area is accessed by completing the Academy Crystal Cave dungeon and taking the lift behind the boss' door.

name: Thops's Barrier
acquisition: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone.

name: Tibia's Summons
acquisition: Drops from the Tibia Mariner at Wyndham Ruins .

name: Unseen Blade
acquisition: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Form

name: Unseen Form
acquisition: Found at the top of Mirage Rise. Can be found alongside Unseen Blade

name: Zamor Ice Storm
acquisition: Snow Witch Sorcery . Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins , by a stone archway.

name: Albinauric Ashes
acquisition: Found on a corpse in the graveyard area east of Caria Manor . This area is accessible only after completing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta .

name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Obtained from defeating the Ancestor Spirit in Siofra River .

name: Ancient Dragon Florissax
acquisition: WARNING: DOING THIS WILL LOCK YOU OUT OF THE PRIESTESS HEART (The one that buffs dragon cult incantations, You can get a different dragon transformations stone called ''Rock Heart'' from another place that buffs dragon communion spells instead.) Find Thiollier near Pillar Path Cross (after the bridge and on your way to dragon's pit, the leftmost/eastmost path leading to a small swamp on map). Exhaust her dialogue. Just to clarify that the road doesn't really lead to the swamp (which is down below the cliff), it just looks like so on the map) Go back to the blessing outside Belurat and talk toMoore. He will give you an item for Thiollier. Deliver the item to Thiollier and exhaust her dialogue again to obtain another item. Give the item to the dragon priestess (near Grand Altar of Dragon Communion) at night, this will put her to sleep. Wait for a few rounds and she will have woken up, exhaust her dialogue. Kill Bayle the Dread. Remember to summon Igon (his sign is within the arena, to the left after you enter the mist) Go to the Altar and talk to her, confess to putting her to sleep and accept to become her lord. collect her ash.

name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff
acquisition: Spirit Ash Summon. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor found in the Sainted Hero's Grave .

name: Archer Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse tucked behind a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Located on a corpse after taking the rotating lift down in Raya Lucaria Academy.

name: Azula Beastman Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. The ashes can be found on the sarcophagus in the back.

name: Banished Knight Engvall
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the boss of Murkwater Catacombs: Grave Warden Duelist, after Patch 1.03.

name: Banished Knight Oleg
acquisition: This Spirit is obtained after Defeating the Ulcerated Tree Sprit located within Fringefolk Hero's Grave .

name: Battlemage Hugues (Spirit Ash)
acquisition: Boss of Sellia Evergaol , drops Battlemage Hugues Ashes

name: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
acquisition: The Bigmouth Imp Ashes can be found inside a treasure chest at the Darklight Catacombs location.

name: Black Knife Tiche
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader upon defeat.

name: Black Knight Captain Huw
acquisition: Scorpion River Catacombs . Past the first ceiling with the falling spikes, reach the Yellow Fulgurbloom and turn right, you will see x2 Messmer Soldiers and a Black Knight. Between both of you, there is another ceiling with spikes, be mindful when engaging in combat. Once those enemies are defeated, head to the coffin at the end to find the Spirit Ashes.

name: Black Knight Commander Andreas
acquisition: It's located by following the Fog Rift Catacombs past a black knight guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers and then jumping on to the top of the spike trap the falls from the ceiling and then crossing it into a corridor. The Spirit Ashes is lying in a coffin.

name: Blackflame Monk Amon
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear boss found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree .

name: Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes
acquisition: Dropped by the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
acquisition: Dropped by the Red Wolf of the Champion

name: Clayman Ashes
acquisition: Located on a corpse in Ainsel River, Lake of Liurnia which is south from the Uhl Palace Ruins. Easiest way to reach these is ashes is while doing Ranni's questline (the portal you enter from Renna's Rise will take you near the ashes). After entering Ainsel River proceed south along the tunnel entering into the next main room with enemies, proceed southwest while hugging the edge until you can find some Clayman walking about, after disposing them look for the corpse near the corner of the area by the top of a waterfall.

name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
acquisition: Located in a chest protected by a knight in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree . From the Prayer Room site of grace, head straight down a few sets of stairs until you reach a small landing where two crossbow guards are stationed above. Jump over the railing on the landing onto the angled brace, then jump onto the platform with the gazebo. The ashes are in a chest in a room next to the gazebo.

name: Crystalian Ashes
acquisition: Located in a chest protected by three masked magic users in a room that is located down a pathway up the purple crystals next to the Trio Putrid Crystallin's (bosses) boss door in�� Sellia Hideaway .

name: Curseblade Meera
acquisition: This item is obtained as a reward for defeating Curseblade Smith found within Bonny Gaol .

name: Demi-Human Ashes
acquisition: Found within Impaler's Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog

name: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh
acquisition: This spirit ash drops from the Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze boss located within the depths of the Belurat Gaol .

name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found behind a hidden room in the secret passageway of Volcano Manor . After heading in the secret passage, before going downstairs, turn left and go through the hallway full of snails. At the dead end where you get the cookbook, smack the left wall to reveal the hidden room.

name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Climb the crumbled structure of the building in Temple Town Ruins which can only be reachbed by jumping on the Spiritspring. Once on top, turn right and jump to the platform. Move forward inside the cave, turn left and enter the room with a chest containing this item.

name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
acquisition: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

name: Dung Eater Puppet
acquisition: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater. Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

name: Fanged Imp Ashes
acquisition: Ashes remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
acquisition: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

name: Fingercreeper Ashes
acquisition: Go east from Fingerstone hill Grace. You'll find a two fingers emote but continue onward until you find 2 leech-men as well as 2 hands buried in the ground. Soon after those hands there's an opening in the ground by the cliff guarded by many fingercreepers. Drop down and face against a GIANT hand, defeat it (fire works well) and grab the spirit ashes.

name: Fire Knight Hilde
acquisition: Shadow Keep - accessed from the Church District Side. From the gear in which you found Wrath from Afar, jump towards the next platform and head to the ladder on the left. Climb it up. Once at the top, take the wooden beam on your left and turn right towards the lift. Activate the lift but quickly return to the platform. Another lift will appear do the same, and jump on the first lift Roof. Stay there until it stops. Jump across the platform to reach the corpse on the other side and loot the Spirit Ash.

name: Fire Knight Queelign
acquisition: Use Iris of Grace on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive the Spirit Ash Fire Knight Queelign .

name: Fire Monk Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. Continue through this path past two frost breath traps. The spell is found in a chest behind the second trap.

name: Giant Rat Ashes
acquisition: Can be found in a wooden shack located left of the windwill.

name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
acquisition: Inside Road's End Catacombs. Defeat the Spirit-Caller Snail to obtain.

name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.

name: Gravebird Ashes
acquisition: Use the spiritspring to reach the area, you'll find this item surrounded by gravestones.

name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in a graveyard in Nokron, Eternal City guarded by a Fallen Hawk .

name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found under a large decorative chalice in the northern edge of the main city proper.

name: Horned Warrior Ashes
acquisition: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the left side.

name: Inquisitor Ashes
acquisition: They can be found on a corpse in Enir-Ilim, beneath the second to last enemy before reaching the Spiral Rise site of grace (coming from First Rise site of grace).

name: Jarwight Puppet
acquisition: Spirit Ashes . Can be bought from a body in Seluvis's Rise for Starlight Shards after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

name: Jolán and Anna
acquisition: Found at the very top of Rabbath's Rise, only accessible by carefully dropping down from the Hinterlands area above. You can only obtain this Ashes if you progressed Count Ymir's questline and finished Jolan's invasion, then gave her the IRIS OF GRACE to obtain her Spirit Ashes. Interact with the puppet in this room and you can merge Jolan and Anna to create this spirit ash. You can interact again to undo the merge.

name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
acquisition: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in the Caelid Catacombs .

name: Land Squirt Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Found inside the Sainted Hero's Grave . After a floor collapsed, make your way back up and retrieve from a corpse.

name: Lhutel the Headless
acquisition: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs

name: Lone Wolf Ashes
acquisition: Given to players by Renna at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave. Return to the Church after getting the ability to summon your Spectral Steed from Melina . You will find Renna sitting by the ruins of the church.

name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs .

name: Man-Fly Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes looted from a grub corpse in Village of the Flies. Can only be accessed by going down the river from Shadow Keep and unlocking the Recluses River Downstream site of grace area. The Ashes are found on the top part of the village, guarded by two shadow casters and several man-fly enemies.

name: Man-Serpent Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found on an altar protected by some enemies in Volcano Manor's dungeon.

name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
acquisition: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Found at the far north cliff, by breaking a petrified tree.

name: Messmer Soldier Ashes
acquisition: From the area where you fight the Omenkiller, cross the whole room to the other side, it will lead outside, You will find the spirit ashes near a grave.

name: Mimic Tear Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue door in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found behind a hidden wall in Caelid Catacombs . You must attack a wall to the right of the staircase to reveal a path to the ashes.

name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
acquisition: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux. Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart.
