Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill. A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

name: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in a chest locked behind an imp statue in Nokstella, Eternal City protected by two Swordstresses .

name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
acquisition: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs .

name: Nomad Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the capital. This is in a large, multi-level section in the east.

name: Omenkiller Rollo
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.

name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
acquisition: Miquella's Haligtree near Haligtree Town site of grace

name: Page Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.

name: Perfumer Tricia
acquisition: Optional Duo Boss Fight. Perfumer Tricia is found at the end of the Unsightly Catacombs and is accompanied by a Misbegotten Warrior.

name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Dropped by the boss of Gaol Cave : Frenzied Duelist

name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes found within War-Dead Catacombs Go up the stairs to the back right of the first room and go left. Past the archer at the end of the hall turn right, turning right again at the end of that hall past the greatsword knight. Jump through the window to the right near the end of this hall. Go left up the stairs and the ashes will be in a room in front of you behind a knight.

name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
acquisition: Found inside a chest at the end of the Road's End Catacombs . Hit the final wall to dispel the illusion, allowing you to move on. Beware of the many Imps in the final room.

name: Redmane Knight Ogha
acquisition: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in the War-Dead Catacombs located in eastern Caelid. To find the entrance of the catacombs, travel to the site of grace that appears after defeating Starcourge Radahn and proceed to head north until you have reached the upper most corner of the area, you'll be able to see the small door along the cliffside.

name: Rotten Stray Ashes
acquisition: Found on a body within a broken building, there is a Rotten Stray nearby.

name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ash that drops from the Tibia Mariner

name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village .

name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist boss at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb .

name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
acquisition: In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.

name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
acquisition: Obtained from Roderika form Stormhill Shack while pursuing her questline.

name: Stormhawk Deenh
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found in a chest on the wooden walkway above the southern wing's main room. Accessible from where The Stormhawk King key item is found.

name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
acquisition: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Eye of Occulation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes. Note: if you don't get these spirit ashes, you cannot get the "Jolan and Anna" spirit ashes either.

name: Taylew the Golem Smith
acquisition: Return to the platform in the middle that you have moved with the lever, and head up. Jump to the left once you are near the top. Take the stairs up in the area, and interact with the furnace to receive the Spirit Ashes along with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
acquisition: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade boss of the Black Knife Catacombs

name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ashes found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading north to find a hidden area on the right with a statue. Head into the corridor behind the statue and to the right to access a small room where a corpse holding the ashes can be found.

name: Wandering Noble Ashes
acquisition: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes

name: Warhawk Ashes
acquisition: Rewarded upon finding the location Prophecy Painting depicts. The location is north of the Church of Pilgrimage .

name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
acquisition: Spirit Ash. Found on a corpse in a pit inside the Unsightly Catacombs .

name: Stonesword Key #1
acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

name: Stonesword Key #2
acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting in a chair at the northern edge of the plateau, overlooking the sea.

name: Stonesword Key #3
acquisition: Stoneword Key Found on the ground by a wooden barricade at the southern end of the Bridge of Sacrifice .

name: Stonesword Key #4
acquisition: Held by a corpse within Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Look for the body on a platform above the chariot.

name: Stonesword Key #5
acquisition: Stoneword Key Found inside a small room, protected by a Rat.

name: Stonesword Key #6
acquisition: Stoneword Key found at Stormhill Shack next to the Site of Grace.

name: Stonesword Key #7
acquisition: Found within the Gaol Cave , near Wakizashi .

name: Stonesword Key #8
acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse inside a building section with a broken roof. Accessed from the very top of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

name: Stonesword Key #9
acquisition: Held by a corpse above the Grafted Scion .

name: Stonesword Key #10
acquisition: At Stormveil Castle's Underground Crypt.

name: Stonesword Key #11
acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse sitting high above on a ledge connecting two buildings. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

name: Stonesword Key #12
acquisition: On top of a large rock with bodies and chairs on top.

name: Stonesword Key #13
acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found on a body in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well , near the cliff.

name: Stonesword Key #14
acquisition: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse on a ledge on the outside of the tower. Accessible via careful platforming.

name: Stonesword Key #15
acquisition: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy .

name: Stonesword Key #16
acquisition: Found in Raya Lucaria through an Illusory Wall just before the Site of Grace at Debate Parlor.

name: Stonesword Key #17
acquisition: Looted on a fountain, center of the academy's courtyard.

name: Stonesword Key #18
acquisition: Found inside the Academy Crystal Cave . Head to the left to where the Sages are, and enter the next room. You will find it inside a cage.

name: Stonesword Key #19
acquisition: Held by a sitting corpse outside the Academy , beneath the bridge.

name: Stonesword Key #20
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a body sitting on a chair, in the open field, north from Ainsel River Well.

name: Stonesword Key #21
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

name: Stonesword Key #22
acquisition: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.

name: Stonesword Key #23
acquisition: Crafting Material. Three can be looted from a corpse on the Western Walls of Caria Manor. It is guarded by a Giant Crab.This area can only be reached by dropping down from Three Sisters after defeating the main boss, and finding the path from the south-west of the chapel's rooftop.

name: Stonesword Key #24
acquisition: Stonesword Key. One found in the Sealed Tunnel . At the bottom of the chamber with the lift, dispel two illusory walls to the south. In the next chamber, walk on the overgrown root and jump to the right onto the wooden platform below, right in front of a tunnel. Follow the tunnel to find the key on a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #25
acquisition: Found on a corpse located on a camp northeast from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

name: Stonesword Key #26
acquisition: Found on a corpse below West Capital Rampart Site of Grace . Drop down, jump on petrified dragon foot onto barn, then into 2nd story wooden building.

name: Stonesword Key #27
acquisition: On top of a gazebo, held by a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #28
acquisition: Found on a small shack past the Fortified Manor, west of the Lower Capital Chuch Site of Grace. You have to jump around in order to reach it. There is a Smithing Stone (6) on that same shack.

name: Stonesword Key #29
acquisition: Found in front of a grave, there are three enemies in the vicinity

name: Stonesword Key #30
acquisition: Found in the lower platform, open a door and find it inside the chest.

name: Stonesword Key #31
acquisition: On the rooftop of one of the buildings, held by a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #32
acquisition: Stonesword Key . One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds . From the Underground Roadside site of grace, head northeast and drop down into an opening in the ground to enter the aqueducts. From here, head northwest past the rats and look for a tunnel on the right. Follow this tunnel until you see slimes and drop into the hole in front of them. Follow the path all the way to the end to grab the key on a corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #33
acquisition: At Auriza Hero's Grave , one can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

name: Stonesword Key #34
acquisition: Stonesword Key. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps then turn right to reach a second Chariot hall where two chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find the key on a corpse between two ramps.

name: Stonesword Key #35
acquisition: Held by a Noble's sitting corpse.

name: Stonesword Key #36
acquisition: Can be found behind an illusory wall, in the same room where you fight an Axe Skeleton, within Sage's Cave

name: Stonesword Key #37
acquisition: Found at the exit of Rya's room, reachable through the window.

name: Stonesword Key #38
acquisition: Held by a corpse lying on the stairs within the Volcano Manor area.

name: Stonesword Key #39
acquisition: Key Item. Found under a large burnt tree near the cliffs.

name: Stonesword Key #40
acquisition: Found on a body on a stone ledge, reached by traversing the rocks leading from the eastern wall all the way to the ledge. A set of slugs can be found underneath looking at the body.

name: Stonesword Key #41
acquisition: Stonesword Key found on a corpse on a broken bridge near Corpse-Stench Shack .

name: Stonesword Key #42
acquisition: Stonesword Key. Held by a corpse in front of the fort's entrance.

name: Stonesword Key #43
acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found inside a small open structure in the northern section of the ruins.

name: Stonesword Key #44
acquisition: Held by a corpse sitting on a chair, near the edge of the cliff.

name: Stonesword Key #45
acquisition: Stonesword Key held by a corpse located on the rooftop in the northern section.

name: Stonesword Key #46
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy right behind you when you enter the area.

name: Stonesword Key #47
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse lying at the tip of a branch in Miquella's Haligtree canopy.

name: Stonesword Key #48
acquisition: Stonesword Key found on a corpse at the very end of a tall ruined wall in Siofra River . A gust of wind can be found at the edge of the cliff closest to the ruin, boosting you up to the top.

name: Stonesword Key #49
acquisition: Stonesword Key. Found on a corpse by the cliffs east of the mausoleum, behind some praying corpses.

name: Stonesword Key #50
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying by a ledge overlooking the ruined temple in Nokron, Eternal City with the deer carcass. This ledge is a level lower than the cliff with the spirit jellyfish.

name: Stonesword Key #51
acquisition: Stonesword Key found by climbing across the wall's support beams and pillars in Siofra River .

name: Stonesword Key #52
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .

name: Stonesword Key #53
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying on a ledge overlooking the waters of Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Stonesword Key #54
acquisition: At the top of the high building, accessed by jumping on the Spiritspring behind.

name: Aged One's Exultation
acquisition: Talisman dropped by the Winter Lantern enemy you kill nearest to the Abandoned Church. These enemies can only be killed by executing a parry and riposte just as they are about to catch you.

name: Ailment Talisman
acquisition: The Ailment Talisman can be looted from a corpse. The body can be found lying at the edge of an unfinished wooden bridge of the Abandoned Ailing Village.

name: Ancestral Spirit's Horn
acquisition: Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit.

name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
acquisition: Found in a chest inside the Tower above Stormgate that can be accessed going all around it.

name: Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman
acquisition: Found on top of a tower at Fog Rift Fort . From within the door of the tower where Black Knight Garrew was, go through a gap between the tower and the rock wall to the right of the door. Take the stairs going up around the cliff, then at the top take the ladder to the right going up the upper level of the tower. On reaching the top turn left to take another latter leading to the uppermost level of the tower, where a treasure chest resides that holds the Talisman.

name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
acquisition: Found in the chest at the top of the tower next to the Impassable Greatbridge.

name: Arsenal Charm
acquisition: An iron charm that resembles a mass of weaponry. Boosts maximum equipment load. This talisman was derived from an unusual greatsword, once wielded by a hero hungry for vengeance.

name: Arsenal Charm +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down on the left side to an overgrown root below. Follow the root going upwards to reach an upper balcony above where you can loot the talisman from a corpse.

name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
acquisition: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin found inside Black Knife Catacombs.

name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
acquisition: Dropped by Black Knife Assassin , found inside Deathtouched Catacombs.

name: Axe Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a cellar underneath the Mistwood Ruins .

name: Beloved Stardust
acquisition: Given by Ymir after ringing the hanging bell in the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

name: Blade of Mercy
acquisition: Once you head up on the left side of the building, cross to the other side using the cloth-like material as a bridge, and enter the door on the left. Open the chest inside to find the item.

name: Blessed Blue Dew Talisman
acquisition: Talisman, at the altar of the Church of Benediction .

name: Blessed Dew Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest west of the Divine Bridge Site of Grace. Guarded by a Golem.

name: Blue Dancer Charm
acquisition: Dropped by the Guardian Golem within Highroad Cave

name: Blue-Feathered Branchsword
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Stormhill)

name: Boltdrake Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse sitting against a tall brazier.

name: Boltdrake Talisman +1
acquisition: An upgraded version of the Boltdrake Talisman. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging off an opening in a tall tower south of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Reaching this area is a bit complex: You will first need to head southeast to the large plaza guarded by a stationary Farum Azula Dragon which is constantly raining red lightning all around the area. From here, drop down a series of cliffs to the east to reach the opening at the bottom of a large building. Follow the linear path here to a balcony with a ladder leading up to a terrace. Directly in front of the ladder is a lift building. Take the lift up to a series of slopes leading to a hallway underneath the same bridge you crossed to get to the southeast plaza. Fight your way through the hallway to reach a ladder at the end. Climb up the ladder to reach the opening where the corpse holding the talisman can be found.

name: Boltdrake Talisman +3
acquisition: Shadow Keep . From the Storehouse Site of Grace, First Floor, take the small stairs up and turn right while on the wooden platform. You will be attacked by a Fire Knight at a Distance, jump at what appears to be a dining area with tables and chairs to find the item there.

name: Bull-Goat's Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse inside Dragonbarrow Cave .

name: Carian Filigreed Crest
acquisition: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
acquisition: Talisman dropped by Bloodhound Knight , the miniboss of Lakeside Crystal Cave

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse hanging by a wooden ledge above the southern walls of the castle. This area is accessed by climbing a ladder behind the church in the southeast and following the walls west. Beware the very powerful dual sword knight guarding the area. He can teleport behind you and perform very long combos.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +2
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an underground room in the northwest section of the Lunar Estate Ruins . The entrance is sealed by both an Imp Statue that requires 1 Stonesword Key , as well as an illusory floor that can be dispelled with an attack.

name: Cerulean Amber Medallion +3
acquisition: A +3 variant of the Cerulean Amber Medallion can be obtained after defeating the Death Knight .

name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
acquisition: Found at Carian Study Hall . look for it at the rafters, next to a body.

name: Cerulean Seed Talisman +1
acquisition: Can be found at the center of the Finger Ruins of Dheo. You need to sound the hanging bell to acquire this talisman.

name: Clarifying Horn Charm
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse lying on the stairs leading to the lift going up to the Deep Siofra Well .

name: Clarifying Horn Charm +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse in the middle and at the lowest floor of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Clarifying Horn Charm +2
acquisition: Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the small cave infested with rats, continue following the path and go straight. You'll find this talisman on a corpse on the right side once you enter the area.

name: Claw Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse atop a tower accessible by ladder. The tower has several none-hostile Eagles at the top.

name: Companion Jar
acquisition: A talisman given by the jars to their friends. Raises potency of thrown jars.

name: Concealing Veil
acquisition: Talisman dropped by the Black Knife Assassin boss within Sage's Cave

name: Crepus's Vial
acquisition: Talisman . Dropped by Rileigh the Idle after successfully invading his world.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion
acquisition: Crimson Amber Medallion +2 . Held by a corpse hanging over one of the wooden beams on your way down.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +1
acquisition: Talisman. Found at the top of a room locked behind an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +2
acquisition: By falling down the sewers gate, on the beam below, just before fully entering the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds

name: Crimson Amber Medallion +3
acquisition: A +3 variant of the Crimson Amber Medallion drops as a reward upon defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

name: Crimson Seed Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a room inside the Sainted Hero's Grave , locked behind an Imp Statue seal. The room is right in front of the Site of Grace near the entrance and requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Crimson Seed Talisman +1
acquisition: In the center of the Finger Ruins of Rhia. Go to the large ring of fingers (as shown by the Ruins Map given by Count Ymir), and then sound the hanging bell from one of the fingers that's pointing down. The Hole-Laden Necklace given by Ymir is required to sound it.

name: Crucible Feather Talisman
acquisition: Talisman found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave . Reaching it is quite complex: From the first Chariot Hall, drop down through the opening on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps, then turn right into the next corridor that leads to a large hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down towards the pit behind the pillars. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams that you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards the archway with a ladder at the back. Climb the ladder to reach a third Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Head all the way down this hall, using the alcove on the left about halfway through to avoid the Chariot (unless you've previously destroyed it). At the bottom, turn left into a corridor and head straight to find a small room guarded by an Omen . The talisman can be found on a corpse behind the Omen, sitting by a statue.

name: Crucible Knot Talisman
acquisition: Dropped by Omenkiller , located in the Village of the Albinaurics

name: Crucible Scale Talisman
acquisition: Leyndell Catacombs , Altus Plateau . Found in the mini-dungeon directly behind the fire pillar trap is a room with an Omen enemy guarding the item on an altar.

name: Crusade Insignia
acquisition: The Crusade Insignia Talisman is acquired upon defeating the Fire Knight Queelign NPC Invader.

name: Curved Sword Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in Stormveil Castle, a chest inside a dark room in the Wine Cellar with the Banished Knight .

name: Daedicar's Woe
acquisition: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.

name: Dagger Talisman
acquisition: Talisman . Found in a room locked by an imp statue in the Volcano Manor dungeon. The room is opposite the balcony where you find the Volcano Manor Waygate. Once inside, drop down two cages, then look for a red candle behind you that shows an obscure pathway to the talisman.

name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear. Once on the roof, drop through one of the holes onto the wooden beams below and then carefully make your way onto the platform after killing the Pests from range.

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
acquisition: Talisman found on one of the edges of Bestial Sanctum

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1
acquisition: Can be found in a locked imp's room in Sainted Hero's Grave .

name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a small platform underneath one of the upper ones to find the corpse with the talisman.

name: Dried Bouquet
acquisition: Found in a small room hidden behind debris in the area you fight several Man-Fly enemies. From where you got the Bone Bow, as you exit the doorway, make a hard left and you'll see a pile of rubble that you can jump on and you'll see there's a secret room tucked behind it. Go inside a large storeroom where you can find the following items: x5 Thin Beast Bones, x1 Scadutree Fragment, and x1 Dried Bouquet. You can click on the images below to enlarge them.

name: Erdtree's Favor
acquisition: Head down until you see the path narrow on both sides and drop just at the edge where it begins to find a secret area. Defeat the imps and proceed past the fire trap to find the item resting at an altar. Two Grafted Scions wait hanging above, so be sure to avoid them when they land and grab it really quickly

name: Erdtree's Favor +1
acquisition: Found inside a chest, in the room where you fight Mohg, The Omen

name: Erdtree's Favor +2
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman . This Talisman may only be accessed near endgame/post-game. Found on top of a branch jutting out of the ground in a large courtyard, guarded by three Ulcerated Tree Spirits .

name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
acquisition: Located on a corpse guarded by two Prawn Miner inside Sellia Crystal Tunnel

name: Fine Crucible Feather Talisman
acquisition: Climb up on the first tree branch and jump on the second one on the left to find the talisman.

name: Fire Scorpion Charm
acquisition: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation. Found next to the talking spirit on the top of the walls.

name: Flamedrake Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula boss inside Groveside Cave .

name: Flamedrake Talisman +1
acquisition: Found on the ground, against a column. The path is a blocked by a magic barrier if Morgott has not been defeated. You can still reach it by going slightly

name: Flamedrake Talisman +2
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula duo bosses in Dragonbarrow Cave .

name: Flamedrake Talisman +3
acquisition: A +3 variation of the Flamedrake Talisman can be found inside a chest. You'll have to go over the cages and on the right side, you'll find the chest that contains the talisman.

name: Flock's Canvas Talisman
acquisition: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.

name: Furled Finger's Trick-Mirror
acquisition: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

name: Godfrey Icon
acquisition: Talisman . Dropped by Godefroy the Grafted when defeated.

name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble upon their defeat in the Spiritcaller's Cave .

name: Gold Scarab
acquisition: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

name: Golden Braid
acquisition: The talisman can be looted from the ground, in front of a statue of Marika that is inside a tree trunk near the Shaman Village. The Shaman Village is located in Scaduview, which can be accessed by using the O Mother gesture in front of the statue of Marika located near the Back Gate Site of Grace of the Shadow Keep.

name: Graven-Mass Talisman
acquisition: Talisman found in a chest atop the Albinauric Rise tower.

name: Graven-School Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found beyond the illusory wall before the Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight. Go up the ladder close to the Debate Hall Site of Grace and then down the hole to another the room with potboys. This opens the door inaccessible as you entered this area.

name: Great-Jar's Arsenal
acquisition: Reward for completing the 3 duelist NPC invasions in Dragonbarrow (Caelid North) for The Great-Jar. You will only be able to access this area by coming up from Siofra Deep River Well in the underground.

name: Greatshield Talisman
acquisition: Found in a chest on a Wagon East of Grace "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" behind Ancient Dragon Lansseax.

name: Green Turtle Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in an underground area filled with Turtles . The entrance is found slightly south-east of Summonwater Village and requires 1 Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Haligdrake Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Drop down from the cliff near the Seaside Ruins site of grace. Explore the lower area and between fallen columns, there is a small entrance. Enter and take the path until you fing a hanging body.There you will find the Haligdrake Talisman - this is the unreachable item seen in the Cave of Knowledge starting tutorial

name: Haligdrake Talisman +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse next to a Lesser Spirit-Caller Snail inside the Leyndell Catacombs . From the Lyndell Catacombs site of grace, head up the elevator in the southeast to find a room with 3 spirit crossbowmen. Look next to the stairs for an illusory wall. Hit it to dispel the illusion, and then hit the wall on the left to dispel another illusion. The corpse and snail are found in here.

name: Haligdrake Talisman +2
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse by a small cluster of graves southwest of the blood marsh.

name: Hammer Talisman
acquisition: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.

name: Host's Trick-Mirror
acquisition: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.

name: Immunizing Horn Charm
acquisition: Talisman. Found on one of the corpses in this ant nest.

name: Immunizing Horn Charm +1
acquisition: Found in the Lake of Rot by killing the Ancestral follower SE of the Lake of Rot Shore Grace

name: Immunizing Horn Charm +2
acquisition: Talisman. +2 Version of the Immunizing Horn Charm is dropped by the Lesser Ulcerated Spirit that appears in the poison swamp area of Belurat Tower Settlement.

name: Kindred of Rot's Exultation
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Kindred of Rot .

name: Lance Talisman
acquisition: Found at the north of Limgrave past the main road close to the edge.

name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
acquisition: Found in Wyndham Catacombs in a room sealed by an Imp Statue, requires a Stonesword Key .

name: Longtail Cat Talisman
acquisition: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the bottom section of the large rotating lift. Past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy, simply ride the lift down and defeat the single Pendulum Statue enemy.

name: Lord of Blood's Exultation
acquisition: Drops from Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs .

name: Magic Scorpion Charm
acquisition: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.

name: Marika's Scarseal
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the base of the waterfall found at the highest level of Siofra River . It is close to where the Dragonkin Soldier is fought.

name: Marika's Soreseal
acquisition: Talisman . Found on an altar in a room requiring 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock. This room is in the southeast, on the lower levels.

name: Millicent's Prosthesis
acquisition: When you are given the choice between assisting Millicent and challenging her, choose to challenge her. When you kill her, you will automatically receive this talisman.

name: Moon of Nokstella
acquisition: Talisman . Found in a chest underneath a massive throne in Nokstella, Eternal City .

name: Mottled Necklace
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse at the edge of the ruined bridge. This area is accessed via Waygate from The Four Belfries .

name: Mottled Necklace +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on top of some ruined arches in Nokron, Eternal City .

name: Mottled Necklace +2
acquisition: Talisman found in the upper area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the spiritspring in the area to reach the platform to the east and go up the stairs, at the end of the path you'll find a chest with this Talisman.

name: Old Lord's Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a rotunda on the east edge of the Dragon Temple Rooftop area. This area is accessed by heading north from the Great Bridge and entering the building there. Exit onto the balcony on the right and take the ladder nearby down to the walkway leading to the rotunda. Beware as the chest is surrounded by Beastmen and, if you've killed Rykard in the Volcano Manor , you will be invaded by Recusant Bernahl on the walkway.

name: Outer God Heirloom
acquisition: Found inside a chest, at the top of Prospect Town. Inside a small building.

name: Pearl Shield Talisman
acquisition: Found inside a chest in a small camp of Messmer soldiers in the woods. Southwestern of Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace.

name: Pearldrake Talisman
acquisition: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in an cellar near the top of the Wyndham Ruins . The entrance requires a Stonesword Key to unlock.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +2
acquisition: Talisman . Down the steps and up the ladder from the Haligtree Town Site of Grace, there is a Rot Grease. The platform behind that has the Pearldrake Talisman.

name: Pearldrake Talisman +3
acquisition: After using the lever to move the statues in Specimen Storeroom, head to the second floor where the Fire Knight is gazing at the center of the room in the wooden structure. Head to his right and reach the rail to find the statue's head with this item.

name: Perfumer's Talisman
acquisition: In a chest underground below stairs in the room with the yellow Giant Poison Flower.

name: Primal Glintstone Blade
acquisition: Talisman. Found in an underground area of the Stargazer's Ruins . The entrance is sealed by a barrier and there is a talking jellyfish atop the steps. Summon the Spirit Jellyfish next to her to unlock the seal.

name: Prince of Death's Cyst
acquisition: Dropped by a Runebear, fiound in a cave behind a waterfall

name: Prince of Death's Pustule
acquisition: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit . The body can be found next to a giant face.

name: Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom
acquisition: Finish the sidequest given by Gowry in Caelid, then return to Millicent to receive the talisman.

name: Radagon Icon
acquisition: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

name: Radagon's Scarseal
acquisition: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor

name: Radagon's Soreseal
acquisition: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.

name: Red-Feathered Branchsword
acquisition: Dropped by the Deathbird at Liurnia of the Lakes

name: Rellana's Cameo
acquisition: The talisman can be looted on top of an altar inside a chapel.

name: Ritual Shield Talisman
acquisition: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, follow the marble stairway heading South-Southwest, past a Valiant Gargoyle near a Golden Seed and up the stair toward a giant Colloseum, the talisman is at the top of the hill, in front of the door of the Colloseum.

name: Ritual Sword Talisman
acquisition: Located in Lux Ruins , in a chest after defeating Demi-Human Queen Gilika

name: Roar Medallion
acquisition: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll . Located in Limgrave Tunnels.

name: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia
acquisition: Earned after choosing to assist Millicent and successfully defeat her sisters.

name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

name: Sacrificial Twig
acquisition: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

name: Shabriri's Woe
acquisition: Found on a body at the edge of the Frenzied Flame Village

name: Shard of Alexander
acquisition: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

name: Sharpshot Talisman
acquisition: Found inside Albinauric's Shack

name: Shattered Stone Talisman
acquisition: Moorth Ruins. Fall on the first rooftop visible from the gap on the ground, turn left, and walk on the ledge to find the Talisman.

name: Silver Scarab
acquisition: Found in a chest in Hidden Path to the Haligtree . The chest is found past an illusory wall, behind a Grave Glovewort (9) inside the first alcove that you can access by jumping down onto the invisible walkways under the staircase in the main hall.

name: Smithing Talisman
acquisition: The talisman is looted from a corpse. The body is inside a room filled with Fire Blob enemies, on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

name: Spear Talisman
acquisition: Talisman found in a chest within Lakeside Crystal Cave

name: Spelldrake Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave .

name: Spelldrake Talisman +1
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in a chest in a small room the northwest section of town. Right below where the Staff of Loss is obtained. This room is initially sealed by a barrier that can be dispelled by lighting a brazier atop a tower in the southwest of town.

name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
acquisition: Upgraded Talisman. Found in the secret catacombs underneath the Hidden Path to the Haligtree by turning right just before the Stray Mimic Tear 's boss door, following the corridor and taking the lift up. The talisman is found on a corpse in an alcove at the top.

name: Spelldrake Talisman +3
acquisition: A +3 variant of the Spelldrake Talisman can be looted off a corpse. The body is located inside a storeroom underneath the castle front bridge of Castle Ensis.

name: St. Trina's Smile
acquisition: Obtained as a drop upon defeating Thiollier. Thiollier only becomes a hostile enemy if you pursue Thiollier and St. Trina's NPC quest. Please visit the Thiollier or St.Trina 's page for the NPC quest guide.

name: Stalwart Horn Charm
acquisition: Can be found in Eastern Liurnia. Fast travel to Mausoleum Compound, head up the light incline to the left towards the cliff to the West. When you are at the cliff, look South for a hole in the wall. The talisman can be found on a corpse on a cliff through the hole.

name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
acquisition: Found to the east of Yelough Anix Tunnel

name: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
acquisition: Bonny Gaol. After you jump down the hole, head east past the rats and climb up the ladder. Defeat the Inner Jar monster, you will find the talisman in the room.

name: Stargazer Heirloom
acquisition: Talisman . Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .

name: Starscourge Heirloom
acquisition: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael . It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

name: Taker's Cameo
acquisition: Talisman . Awarded by Tanith after completing the third letter quest.

name: Talisman of All Crucibles
acquisition: Start at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Starway Site of Grace, and head southwest to the elevator. At the bottom of the elevator looking south west, there are 2 paths of floating platforms, go to the left one, follow it around and it loops to the chest with this talisman.

name: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
acquisition: Can be found beside the big golden tree.

name: Talisman of the Dread
acquisition: Can be found on a corpse inside Elder's Hovel.

name: Twinblade Talisman
acquisition: Talisman. Found in the tower section of the walls of Castle Morne. Climb up the ladder and go around the tower to find a chest containing the talisman.

name: Two Fingers Heirloom
acquisition: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a hidden cellar in the Purified Ruins . The cellar entrance is concealed by wooden planks and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy.

name: Two-Handed Sword Talisman
acquisition: Temple Town Ruins . After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up to the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

name: Two-Headed Turtle Talisman
acquisition: It's inside a cave beneath a waterfall guarded by enemies Just east of Rivermouth Cave

name: Verdigris Discus
acquisition: Ancient Rauh Ruins: Can be found in front of a giant statue in a lower area only accessible by jumping down from the second Divine Beast Lion encounter, or by teleporting to this platform from the waygate in Scadu Altus

name: Viridian Amber Medallion
acquisition: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
acquisition: can be found in Altus Plauteau, south of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace. You should hear Margit whisper, "I see you, Tarnished..." to you before appearing on the road. Defeat him again and it will drop.

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +2
acquisition: The closest site of grace is the Haligtree Town Plaza. Run to the roof with the Summoning Snail, jump to the building on the right (it's lower), immediately turn around and jump inside the building. There will be a chest with the medallion and some mushroom people

name: Viridian Amber Medallion +3
acquisition: Darklight Catacombs : In a chest found by dropping down a ledge in the main area, and going to the archway in the wall

name: Warrior Jar Shard
acquisition: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.

name: Winged Sword Insignia
acquisition: Talisman. Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss inside the Stillwater Cave .

name: Ancestral Infant's Head
acquisition: Key Item. Found in a chest in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Guarded by an Ancestral Follower .

name: Ancient Dragon's Blessing
acquisition: Given by Dragon Communion Priestess located near the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

name: Baldachin's Blessing
acquisition: Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden

name: Blasphemous Claw
acquisition: Reusable Tool. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

name: Blessing of Marika
acquisition: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel .

name: Bloody Finger
acquisition: Key Multiplayer Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item.

name: Blue Cipher Ring
acquisition: Item for online play. Puts the wearer in ready state to answer should someone in another world call for rescue. You will be summoned to their world as a hunter. When summoned to rescue another player, your objective will be to defeat the invader.

name: Bondstone
acquisition: Can be found behind an illusory wall inside a tunnel area guarded by scorpions

name: Duelist's Furled Finger
acquisition: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

name: Finger Severer
acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse by the wall just past the Site of Grace in the Stranded Graveyard. Found along with the Tarnished's Furled Finger .

name: Flask of Cerulean Tears
acquisition: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with cerulean tears, this flask restores FP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

name: Flask of Crimson Tears
acquisition: A sacred flask modelled after a golden holy chalice that was once graced by a tear of life. Filled with crimson tears, this flask restores HP with use. Rest at a site of grace to replenish. It is said that a Finger Maiden will bestow two such chalices upon the chosen Tarnished when they meet.

name: Flask of Wondrous Physick
acquisition: Laying on the ground in front of the statue. Bestows various special effects.

name: Horned Bairn
acquisition: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit found under the Ellac Greatbridge.

name: Iris of Grace
acquisition: Directly below of the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks location. Take the left lift down from the Storehouse, first floor site of grace. Take the first exit to the right and continue forward until the end of the hallway. Kill the enemy, and take the right path down. Kill the enemies and turn left all the way to find the item.

name: Iris of Occultation
acquisition: This item drops from a second Lesser Ulcerated Spirit enemy that can be found around this section of the sunken chapel.

name: Lamenter's Mask
acquisition: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. Dropped by Lamenter at Lamenter's Gaol.

name: Lantern
acquisition: A small waist-worn lantern that illuminates surroundings. Use once to turn on, and again to turn off. While its light is dimmer than that of a torch, it has the advantage of freeing up the user's hands.

name: Margit's Shackle
acquisition: A fetish bathed in golden magic. Shackles were used to bind the accursed people called the Omen, and these ones were made to keep a particular Omen under strictest confinement. Though faint, the shackles still retain vestiges of power — enough to trap the once-bound Margit on earth, if only for a short time.

name: Memory of Grace
acquisition: A phantom vision of the first grace, which once guided the Tarnished to the Lands Between. Lose all runes and return to last site of grace at which you rested. It all repeats. Be seen by the Elden Ring. Become the Elden Lord.

name: Mimic's Veil
acquisition: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

name: Mohg's Shackle
acquisition: A fetish bathed in golden magic.

name: Omen Bairn
acquisition: Doll of a curseborn bairn.

name: Prattling Pate "Apologies"
acquisition: Reusable Item. Found on a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs , along the corridors in the room with the lever that opens the final door.

name: Prattling Pate "Hello"
acquisition: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.

name: Prattling Pate "Lamentation"
acquisition: Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse.

name: Prattling Pate "Let's get to it"
acquisition: Found within Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau . Found by the entrance of the room with the shadow enemy that, when killed, opens the final door.

name: Prattling Pate "My beloved"
acquisition: Pratting Pate " My beloved " can be found on Miquella's Haligtree , shortly after taking the way gate from Ordina, Liturgical Town. It is two branches down from where you are transported to.

name: Prattling Pate "Please help"
acquisition: Found within Impaler's Catacombs , held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.

name: Prattling Pate "Thank you"
acquisition: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs . Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.

name: Prattling Pate "Wonderful"
acquisition: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs , in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.

name: Prattling Pate "You're beautiful"
acquisition: Tool Item. Found by a door just near the Hierodas Glintstone Crown in Hermit Village.

name: Priestess Heart
acquisition: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
acquisition: Key Tool Item. Reward for advancing White-Mask Varre questline and giving him the blood-soaked Lord of Blood's Favor item. Gives player early access to Mohgwyn Dynasty underground.

name: Radiant Baldachin's Blessing
acquisition: Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity. Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor. It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.

name: Recusant Finger
acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found in a locked room with the Letter from Volcano Manor after pledging your services to the Volcano Manor .

name: Regal Omen Bairn
acquisition: Doll of a curseborn bairn from the Erdtree's royal line.  Uses FP to unleash many wraiths that chase down foes.

name: Rock Heart
acquisition: A special item obtained from completing the "Domain of Dragons" Painting puzzle. Allows players to transform into an Ancient Dragon

name: Small Golden Effigy
acquisition: Multiplayer Item. Found on the Summoning Pool a few steps west of The First Step Site of Grace.

name: Small Red Effigy
acquisition: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool.

name: Spectral Steed Whistle
acquisition: A delicate goldwork ring. Can be used as a finger whistle. Sound the whistle to summon and ride spectral steed. (Dismounts steed when used while on horseback.) Upon death, the spectral steed can be summoned again, but doing so consumes the Flask of Crimson Tears.

name: Tarnished's Furled Finger
acquisition: Item for online play. Creates a summon sign for cooperative multiplayer. Your objective will be to defeat the area boss of the world to which you were summoned. A finger of corpse wax, furled like a hook. It is a relic of those who came before, left to help those who would come after.

name: Tarnished's Wizened Finger
acquisition: Can be found at the beginning of the game, on a body against a wall on the right side of the tutorial area.

name: Taunter's Tongue
acquisition: Item for online play. Lures in invaders. This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion. Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader. (When two invaders are present, you will be limited to one cooperator.)

name: Telescope
acquisition: Astrology tool used by members of the Carian royal family. Part of a larger instrument, removed and stolen away. Allows the viewer to better see faraway things. During the age of the Erdtree, Carian astrology withered on the vine. The fate once writ in the night skies had been fettered by the Golden Order.

name: White Cipher Ring
acquisition: Item for online play. Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded. (You may be unable to summon rescuers under certain circumstances). A lost mystic code, enchanted to take the form of a ring. One of the fetishes said to have been bestowed by the Two Fingers.

name: Wraith Calling Bell
acquisition: Offensive Consumable Item. Found in a chest in a small room of an underground aea in the northwestern section of the Laskyar Ruins . Find a set of steps leading downwards to locate the area.

name: Academy Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Staff. Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.

name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
acquisition: Drops from an enemy in the Underground. You have to raise the platforms to get up to him by stepping on the buttons around the swamp. There are two buttons that are next to small columns or obelisks. Once you get raised on the platform, take on the long and narrow path, after a few meters you will be greeted by this enemy. kill him to obtain the Alabastrer Lord's Sword.

name: Albinauric Bow
acquisition: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

name: Albinauric Staff
acquisition: Found in Volcano Manor near the Guest Hall grace. Head left from the bonfire, then left again, taking the stairs to the next floor. Head outside and take the ladder to your left onto the roof. Go to the back of the roof and jump off the right side to be taken to a room with an Omenkiller, the Albinauric Staff, and Albinauric Mask.

name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
acquisition: The weapon is acquired after examining the altar of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The altar is found on the second level. To reach the altar, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

name: Antspur Rapier
acquisition: Thrusting Sword. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.

name: Anvil Hammer
acquisition: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Use the column you have lowered with the lever as a bridge and climb it until the end. Beware of the fire blob, and then at the top, turn right and jump to reach the stairs. Climb them up and interact with a furnace to obtain this weapon and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

name: Arbalest
acquisition: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.

name: Astrologer's Staff
acquisition: Staff of the astrologers. A glintsone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Axe of Godfrey
acquisition: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

name: Axe of Godrick
acquisition: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.

name: Backhand Blade
acquisition: Besides a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies area.

name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
acquisition: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

name: Banished Knight's Halberd
acquisition: An upgraded Banished Knight's Halberd dropped by Edgar the Revenger .

name: Barbed Staff-Spear
acquisition: Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor , and grants 260000 Runes upon defeat.

name: Bastard's Stars
acquisition: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

name: Bastard Sword
acquisition: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is normally wielded with two hands, but those with sufficient strength can wield it in one alone. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

name: Battle Axe
acquisition: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

name: Battle Hammer
acquisition: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs .

name: Beast Claw (weapon)
acquisition: Drops from killing this hostile NPC in Gravesite plains in the forest, southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

name: Beast-Repellent Torch
acquisition: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

name: Beastclaw Greathammer
acquisition: Given by Gurranq after turning in their 7th Deathroot.

name: Beastman's Cleaver
acquisition: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

name: Beastman's Curved Sword
acquisition: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

name: Black Bow
acquisition: Bow that can be found on the roof on the right that overlooks the area. Need to jump from roof to roof in order to reach it.

name: Black Knife
acquisition: Dagger dropped from the Black Knife Assassin

name: Black Steel Greathammer
acquisition: Greathammer dropped by the heavy armored guard of the Church of Consolation. This is a guaranteed drop when you first kill him.

name: Black Steel Twinblade
acquisition: Drops from Black Knight at the top of the hill encampment. He is guarded by many Messmer Soldiers along the way.

name: Blade of Calling
acquisition: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall

name: Blasphemous Blade
acquisition: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family. Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

name: Bloodfiend's Arm
acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Guaranteed drop from the chief Bloodfiend at the top of Prospect Town. One time only.

name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
acquisition: The Bloodfiend west of Taylew's Ruined Forge drops this when killed.

name: Bloodhound Claws
acquisition: Claw. Dropped by the Bloodhound Knight in the secret passage of Volcano Manor .

name: Bloodhound's Fang
acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol , Bloodhound Knight Darriwil .

name: Bloodstained Dagger
acquisition: Dropped by Demihuman chief/Demihuman assassin sleeping before the wooden bridge leading to the minor eldtree in the weeping peninsula.

name: Bloody Helice
acquisition: Can be found inside a chest, in the same room of the boss in Writheblood Ruins

name: Bolt of Gransax
acquisition: Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital after beating Godfrey, First Elden Lord; walk outside of the west door, take the elevator down, and walk up the spear.

name: Bone Bow
acquisition: A Bone Bow can be found being protected by 2 giant Spider-Scorpions, inside the massive tower.

name: Bonny Butchering Knife
acquisition: Below a small shed, outside a house. Near the broken bridge.

name: Brick Hammer
acquisition: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.

name: Broadsword
acquisition: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

name: Butchering Knife
acquisition: Greataxe . Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater .

name: Caestus
acquisition: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

name: Cane Sword
acquisition: West Capital Ramparts Site of Grace, Go south out of the room with the site of grace and down the flight of stairs to the floor underneath, make a complete U-turn in the room with the stairs to find a corpse with the sword

name: Carian Glintblade Staff
acquisition: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .

name: Carian Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Found at the Carian Study Hall.

name: Carian Knight's Sword
acquisition: Straight Sword. Found in a chest at the back of a large stagecoach being pulled by 2 Trolls.

name: Carian Regal Scepter
acquisition: Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries. Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

name: Carian Sorcery Sword
acquisition: In a chest after dropping down into Castle Ensis from Scadu Altus.

name: Celebrant's Cleaver
acquisition: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
acquisition: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Sickle
acquisition: Sickle decorated with flowers and many-coloured fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

name: Celebrant's Skull
acquisition: Warhammer. Found on a corpse at the cliff directly north from Windmill village site of grace

name: Chainlink Flail
acquisition: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
acquisition: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. In a small room at the lower floor area, the first room to the right after exiting the ladder room.

name: Cinquedea
acquisition: Dagger. Found outside the bestial sanctum, after a long series of platforms starting on the west side to drop down onto the external structure's base.

name: Cipher Pata
acquisition: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

name: Clawmark Seal
acquisition: A sacred seal given by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.  The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

name: Claws of Night
acquisition: Dropped by NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna, found in the ruins underneath Cathedral of Manus Metyr. This area can only be accessed by progressing Ymir's questline.

name: Clayman's Harpoon
acquisition: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

name: Claymore
acquisition: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
acquisition: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long- handled armament.

name: Cleanrot Spear
acquisition: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Melania, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shieldd is blessed with an incnantation that wards off rot.

name: Clinging Bone
acquisition: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. ""O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand.""

name: Club
acquisition: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

name: Coded Sword
acquisition: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Look for an abandoned horse stable, then climb onto its roof and enter the building. Keep going until you find a broken round table. Look for the double door. Inside that room you will find the coded sword.

name: Commander's Standard
acquisition: Halberd. Dropped by Commander O'Neil upon defeat.

name: Composite Bow
acquisition: Bow composited from a mix of Materials.  Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
acquisition: Warhammer. Found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave on a corpse at the end of the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the room with the flamethrower pillar.

name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
acquisition: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

name: Crescent Moon Axe
acquisition: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia. Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

name: Cross-Naginata
acquisition: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel , in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.

name: Crystal Knife
acquisition: Dagger. Found in a chest inside the storage room in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel protected by Marionettes.

name: Crystal Spear
acquisition: Can be found inside Sellia Hideaway . It can be found in a chest to the right of the entrance of the second room with huge crystal formations. The hidden wall is on the left side of a corpse

name: Crystal Staff
acquisition: Crystal Staff can be found in Academy Crystal Cave . It's in a room guarded by a sorcerer behind a fog wall, located right before the boss gate. The path to the chest containing the staff is through an illusory rock wall on the left side of the tunnel, just before the stone archway.

name: Crystal Sword
acquisition: CStraight Sword. Can be found at Village of the Albinaurics . Past the well and the wooden bridge, on a body near the edge.

name: Curved Club
acquisition: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

name: Curved Great Club
acquisition: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

name: Dagger
acquisition: Looted from a Foot Soldier upon defeat.

name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
acquisition: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum

name: Dark Moon Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword . Found below the Cathedral of Manus Celes after progressing Ranni 's questline.

name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
acquisition: Can be purchased from the Thiollier for 9000 Runes.

name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
acquisition: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Scorpion River Catacombs .

name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
acquisition: The weapon is obtained as a reward for defeating the Death Knight boss located at the Fog Rift Catacombs .

name: Death Ritual Spear
acquisition: Spear. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird boss upon defeat.

name: Death's Poker
acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.

name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
acquisition: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

name: Devonia's Hammer
acquisition: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .

name: Devourer's Scepter
acquisition: Great Hammer. Dropped by the invader Recusant Bernahl upon defeat.

name: Digger's Staff
acquisition: Drops from Diggers inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .

name: Dismounter
acquisition: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.  A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

name: Dragon Communion Seal
acquisition: Found in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave . Progress down the tunnel with the mechanized chariot until the path splits and you can go either up or down. Go up until you reach the end of the tunnel and inside the small room is an enemy that once killed will give you the weapon.

name: Dragon Greatclaw
acquisition: Colossal Weapon that drops from the Draconic Tree Sentinel

name: Dragon Halberd
acquisition: Halberd. Obtained when defeating the Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River .

name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
acquisition: Dropped by the Ancient Dragon-Man mini-boss located in the Dragon's Pit.

name: Dragon King's Cragblade
acquisition: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

name: Dragonscale Blade
acquisition: Dropped by Dragonkin Soldier

name: Dryleaf Seal
acquisition: Sacred Seal looted from a platform under the message in the lower areas of this region.

name: Duelist Greataxe
acquisition: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

name: Eclipse Shotel
acquisition: Curved Sword. Found at the altar of the Church in the southeast section of the castle.

name: Eleonora's Poleblade
acquisition: Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger

name: Envoy's Greathorn
acquisition: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Envoy's Horn
acquisition: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Envoy's Long Horn
acquisition: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

name: Erdsteel Dagger
acquisition: Dagger. Rewarded by Kenneth Haight for clearing out Fort Haight .

name: Erdtree Bow
acquisition: Climb the root found at the east, head up to the west, once outside again, jump on the roof to the left and enter inside the window. Loot the chest.

name: Erdtree Greatbow
acquisition: Dropped from the Chariot inside Fringefolk Hero's Grave

name: Erdtree Seal
acquisition: Sacred Seal. Found on a corpse in a building close to the Omenkiller in the Volcano Manor dungeon.

name: Estoc
acquisition: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.  For its large size, it can be wirleded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

name: Euporia
acquisition: Found after dropping down a secret area in Enir Ilim, after doing some difficult platforming

name: Executioner's Greataxe
acquisition: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

name: Falchion
acquisition: Dropped by Demi-Human enemies under the bridge.

name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
acquisition: Colossal Weapon Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast

name: Falx
acquisition: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.

name: Family Heads
acquisition: Flail. Dropped from boss of Sage's Cave , Necromancer Garris.

name: Finger Seal
acquisition: A sacred seal given by maidens of the Finger Readers which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations. Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

name: Fire Knight's Seal
acquisition: Shadow Keep . In the area with the giant Queen Marika statue, it is behind the statue. You have to use the lever to lower the water level.

name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
acquisition: Weapon. Found in a chest guarded by both Perfumers and Messmer Soldiers.

name: Flail
acquisition: It can be found in a charriot, defended by a group of soldiers. near the Gatefront Ruins

name: Flamberge
acquisition: Greatsword found on a corpse on the roof of the building in the southeast of Redmane Castle .

name: Flowerstone Gavel
acquisition: The Dragon Communion Priestess drops this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after defeating Bayle The Dread.

name: Flowing Curved Sword
acquisition: Curved Sword. Found within the chest of the Enemy Caravan traveling the Consecrated Snowfield south-western area.

name: Forked Greatsword
acquisition: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue"                   and causes blood loss.

name: Forked Hatchet
acquisition: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

name: Frenzied Flame Seal
acquisition: Weapon. Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.

name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
acquisition: The weapon is looted from a dead body located by the northern interior of the Abandoned Church.

name: Freyja's Greatsword
acquisition: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim .

name: Frozen Needle
acquisition: Thrusting Sword. Found in a chest inside a small room in an underground area of the ruins. The Royal Revenant needs to be defeated to gain access to this room.

name: Full Moon Crossbow
acquisition: Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower. From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint). Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
acquisition: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
acquisition: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
acquisition: Halberd dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
acquisition: Greatsword dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the entrance to the Bestial Sanctum .

name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
acquisition: Dropped by Gargoyle . From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree .Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.

name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
acquisition: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle when both bosses are defeated

name: Gargoyle's Halberd
acquisition: Dropped by the Lesser Black Blade Kindred.

name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
acquisition: Dropped by Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade) when both bosses are defeated

name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.  The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

name: Ghiza's Wheel
acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor .

name: Ghostflame Torch
acquisition: Ghostflame Torch can be found on a body at Nokron, Eternal City. To find it, you must start from the beginning of Nokron, Eternal City, entering from the Meteorite Crater. Once you get to the first set of rooves in Nokron, you will see a derelict tower off to the right of the roof ramp. You will need to jump from the ramp to the tower to reach torch.
