There is no other way to reach the Ghostflame Torch if you proceed to the lower roof platforms of Nokron. There is no way back up except to start over from the Crater again.

name: Giant-Crusher
acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Can be found in a chest inside an unmarked military camp directly to the south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

name: Giant's Red Braid
acquisition: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

name: Giant's Seal
acquisition: Sacred Seal found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave : In the large hall with the Troll, drop down from either side of the platform into a room with a Prelate . Defeat it and check the right side of the room for a corpse holding the seal. Alternatively, you can reach this room by descending the lift and sending it back up. Pull the lever in the alcove to the right and then enter the small space in the raised lift to descend further down. In the next hall, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn left. Climb the ladder at the end of this path.

name: Glaive
acquisition: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

name: Glintstone Kris
acquisition: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

name: Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.  Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

name: Godskin Peeler
acquisition: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle fought at the Windmill Village .

name: Godskin Stitcher
acquisition: Dropped by Godskin Noble

name: Godslayer's Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword found in a chest in a room behind the Godskin Apostle's arena at the Divine Tower of Caelid after defeating him.

name: Godslayer's Seal
acquisition: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion 's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.

name: Golden Epitaph
acquisition: Straight Sword . Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.

name: Golden Halberd
acquisition: Drops from Tree Sentinel

name: Golden Order Greatsword
acquisition: Found inside Cave of the Forlorn . Dropped by Misbegotten Crusader

name: Golden Order Seal
acquisition: Found right at the base of the Minor Erdtree surrounded by the remains of the Church.

name: Golem Greatbow
acquisition: Chance to drop by Golem Archer.

name: Golem's Halberd
acquisition: Dropped by one of the Golems at the bridge.

name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.

name: Grafted Dragon
acquisition: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was granted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

name: Grave Scythe
acquisition: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

name: Gravel Stone Seal
acquisition: From the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, walk north to the next room with the single guard inside. Jump over the balcony railing to get to the area next to the Fortified Manor with the dragon foot. The knight with the spear supported by an archer drops this seal.

name: Great Club
acquisition: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.

name: Great Épée
acquisition: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

name: Great Katana
acquisition: The Great Katana can be found next to the sleeping Ghostflame Dragon on the lake, west of the Abandoned Ailing Village site of grace.

name: Great Knife
acquisition: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to Spinning Slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

name: Great Mace
acquisition: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
acquisition: Greataxe. Dropped by the boss duo of Perfumer's Grotto : Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom .

name: Great Stars
acquisition: On a guarded wagon in Altus Plateau, traveling on the road SouthWest of the Road of Iniquity Side Path site of grace.

name: Greataxe
acquisition: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

name: Greatbow
acquisition: Found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower .

name: Greathorn Hammer
acquisition: Dropped by Ancestral Follower located in Siofra River

name: Greatsword
acquisition: Colossal Sword. Looted from the chest in the enemy caravan traveling the Caelid Highway .

name: Greatsword of Solitude
acquisition: This item is obtained after defeating the Blackgaol Knight . This boss is located inside the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

name: Grossmesser
acquisition: Curved sword boasting a large blade.  This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.  A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

name: Guardian's Swordspear
acquisition: Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.  Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

name: Halberd
acquisition: A long-handed polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.  Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

name: Halo Scythe
acquisition: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

name: Hammer
acquisition: Found inside the Fortified manor, beside the Sanctified Whetblade

name: Hand Axe
acquisition: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

name: Hand Ballista
acquisition: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

name: Hand of Malenia
acquisition: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

name: Harp Bow
acquisition: Acquired by solving the Champion's Song Painting, found in The Shaded Castle

name: Heavy Crossbow
acquisition: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering.

name: Helphen's Steeple
acquisition: Greatsword. Dropped by the Tibia Mariner boss found up on a ridge south of Castle Sol .

name: Highland Axe
acquisition: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.

name: Hookclaws
acquisition: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

name: Horn Bow
acquisition: Bow. Found on a corpse under the stairs leading to Hallowhorn Grounds .

name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
acquisition: Guaranteed drop from the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim.

name: Horned Warrior's Sword
acquisition: Curved Sword dropped by the Horned Warrior found in the norhwestern area of the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp.

name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
acquisition: Whip. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood upon defeat.

name: Icerind Hatchet
acquisition: Axe found inside a chest in the Temple Quarter . The chest is located in what remains of the tower of a ruined building, by some poison flowers.

name: Igon's Greatbow
acquisition: After defeating Bayle the Dread while Igon is summoned, Igon will drop this item at his last location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak Drake.

name: Inquisitor's Girandole
acquisition: Spear . Dropped by the Abductor Virgins .

name: Inseparable Sword
acquisition: Prince of Death's Throne, after giving D's brother D's Twinned Set

name: Iron Ball
acquisition: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart .

name: Iron Cleaver
acquisition: Dropped by one of the enemies that can be found at behind the big door, on the right side.

name: Iron Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

name: Iron Spear
acquisition: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

name: Ivory Sickle
acquisition: Dagger. Can be found at the Village of the Albinaurics .It is up a small hill from the Site of Grace, past a perfumer enemy, behind a coffin. Nearby, Albus hides as a pot.

name: Jar Cannon
acquisition: Ballista. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot when defeated.

name: Jawbone Axe
acquisition: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

name: Katar
acquisition: First Weapon. Looted from a treasure chest in Fort Gael . You can find the chest inside a dark room on the elevated platform above the Lion Guardian.

name: Knight's Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

name: Lamenting Visage
acquisition: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol , you'll need to obtain the Gaol Lower Level Key to gain access.

name: Lance
acquisition: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs . Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

name: Large Club
acquisition: On the lowest cliff south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol , near a spiritspring

name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
acquisition: A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage. Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

name: Leda's Sword
acquisition: Dropped by Needle Knight Leda upon defeat.

name: Light Crossbow
acquisition: Ranged weapoon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
acquisition: Located on a corpse in the middle of a big puddle of water guarded by a rolling lightning ram enemy.

name: Lion Greatbow
acquisition: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with .  Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

name: Longbow
acquisition: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Longhaft Axe
acquisition: Rare drop from enemies wielding it at Castle Mourne in Weeping Peninsula. There is an easy to kill one from Beside the Rampant Gaol site of grace, cross the bridge and will be on the left sleeping.

name: Longsword
acquisition: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its easily-inflicted standard damage, this well- balanced weapon can also perform powerful piercing attacks.

name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword. Found inside a Wagon Chest.

name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
acquisition: Dropped by a head-less, undead Soldier at Fourth Church of Marika.

name: Loretta's War Sickle
acquisition: Halberd. Dropped by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree .

name: Lucerne
acquisition: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.

name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
acquisition: Glintstone Staff. Found in a chest in the building north of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses' chamber after defeating them.

name: Mace
acquisition: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Strinking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances, Most suited to head on slugging matches.

name: Madding Hand (weapon)
acquisition: The weapon is acquired upon defeating the hostile NPC, Madding Hand.

name: Magma Blade
acquisition: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.

name: Magma Whip Candlestick
acquisition: Whip . Rewarded by Patches after completing his Volcano Manor quest.

name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
acquisition: Curved Greatsword dropped by Magma Wyrm Makar

name: Main-gauche
acquisition: Midway through the Stairs, turn right and enter the room. Enter the room on the right, and defeat the enemies to find the body that contains this weapon on the other side.

name: Maliketh's Black Blade
acquisition: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

name: Mantis Blade
acquisition: Dropped by a Cemetary Shade inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . This enemy can be found by heading down the first Chariot hall until you reach a point where there is a pit on either side of the central concrete walkway instead of lava. Drop into the left pit onto some wooden beams and then drop into the room below. The shade is in an alcove in the eastern wall.

name: Marais Executioner's Sword
acquisition: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

name: Marika's Hammer
acquisition: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

name: Maternal Staff
acquisition: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers

name: Meteoric Ore Blade
acquisition: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins .

name: Meteorite Staff
acquisition: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.

name: Milady
acquisition: The Milady Light Greatsword weapon can be found inside a chest. The chest is located at the top of a watchtower.

name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
acquisition: Straight Sword . Found atop a belltower. You can reach this belltower by entering the second alcove on the left of the eastern walkway, heading up the stairs and then jumping onto the tree branch on the balcony. Follow the tree branch up and across to reach the tower.

name: Misbegotten Shortbow
acquisition: There are flying enemies at the top of the castle. Thet may drop this weapon when killed.

name: Miséricorde
acquisition: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
acquisition: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

name: Monk's Flameblade
acquisition: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

name: Monk's Flamemace
acquisition: Warhammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.  The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
acquisition: The weapon drops from defeating the hostile NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

name: Moonveil
acquisition: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel .

name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
acquisition: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.  The accused blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

name: Morning Star
acquisition: Hammer-type Weapon. Found in a chest inside a broken wagon along the road.

name: Nagakiba
acquisition: Can be obtained by completing Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline at the Second Church of Marika

name: Nanaya's Torch
acquisition: From Midra's Library Site of Grace, you'll need to move one of the bookshelves by pulling a lever in the same room. The balcony you need to reach is directly above the inquisitor below. This torch is on a corpse sitting on a chair, wearing a yellow cloth that resembles that of Hyetta.

name: Nightrider Flail
acquisition: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

name: Nightrider Glaive
acquisition: Halberd dropped by miniboss Night's Cavalry . Only appears at night.

name: Noble's Estoc
acquisition: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.  Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

name: Noble's Slender Sword
acquisition: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

name: Nox Flowing Hammer
acquisition: From the Night Sacred Ground Site of Grace in Nokron, go up the stairs to your right. You should find yourself in a room with a Nox Monk and a Silver Tear Ball. Slay these enemies, then ascend a ladder to the back right of the room. Go down the path to the right of the Altar to where you see a Gargoyle Fog Wall. Turn right about halfway down the hallway and you should see a Roof Path out a window with a single Tear Slime. Head to the shingled section of the roof to find a single, unbarred window. Jump through that window to find the Nox Flowing Hammer.

name: Nox Flowing Sword
acquisition: Curved Sword. Dropped by the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest bosses upon defeat.

name: Obsidian Lamina
acquisition: Complete the entirety of Sir Ansbach's questline by assisting him. This weapon will be available at the end of his questline after the Final Boss where he will be by the entrance to the arena after the fight.

name: Omen Cleaver
acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Omen enemy in the northwest section of the courtyard. It is advised to take out all of the lesser enemies nearby before taking on the ogre.

name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
acquisition: Curved Greatsword . Dropped by the Onyx Lord when defeated.

name: Ordovis's Greatsword
acquisition: Greatsword . Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave .

name: Ornamental Straight Sword
acquisition: Straight Sword. Dropped by the Grafted Scion upon defeat.

name: Parrying Dagger
acquisition: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.  For master of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

name: Partisan
acquisition: A Partisan Spear that can be dropped from a Godrick Knight in Fort Haight .

name: Pata
acquisition: Fist Weapon looted from a corpse hanging on the cliff just north from the Church of Benediction . This same corpse has the Oathseeker Set

name: Pest's Glaive
acquisition: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

name: Pickaxe
acquisition: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

name: Pike
acquisition: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace

name: Poisoned Hand
acquisition: Across the previous Knot Resin, there is a Horned Warrior, in a big area. To that area's right, there is a medium-sized building, similar to a church, and beside it, you will find the Poisoned Hand weapon. Note that the building is infested with Man-Fly.

name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
acquisition: Drops from the Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd

name: Prince of Death's Staff
acquisition: Climbing on the roots to reach up the towers, it's in one of them.

name: Pulley Bow
acquisition: Pulley Bow can be found on a sitting corpse (at the top of a siege tower near Mt. Gelmir campsite. The tower is located to the northeast of Gelmir Hero's Grave.

name: Pulley Crossbow
acquisition: Can be found on a body at the Craftsman's Shack

name: Queelign's Greatsword
acquisition: Use Iris of Occultation on the NPC in the Prayer Room to receive Queelign's Greatsword .

name: Rabbath's Cannon
acquisition: Rabbath's Rise. After you free the Spiritspring, head outside and use it while mounted on Torrent to reach the higher part of the tower. Loot the chest at the top to obtain this weapon.

name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
acquisition: Dropped by Rakshasa at Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

name: Rapier
acquisition: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.  As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrust area easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

name: Raptor Talons
acquisition: Located at Sage's Cave , in one of the chests, behind several secret walls

name: Red Bear's Claw
acquisition: Weapon drops upon defeating the Red Bear located at the Northern Nameless Mausoleum .

name: Red Branch Shortbow
acquisition: Drops from an Assassin on the study, past the Trumpeteer

name: Reduvia
acquisition: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

name: Regalia of Eochaid
acquisition: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

name: Repeating Crossbow
acquisition: along the road next to the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South site of Grace

name: Ringed Finger
acquisition: Hammer found inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave . From the first Chariot hallway, head all the way down and turn left at the end of the path to find a room with a chest containing the weapon.

name: Ripple Blade
acquisition: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
acquisition: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

name: Rivers of Blood
acquisition: Katana dropped by NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina . Spawns near the Church of Repose in the later areas of the game.

name: Rogier's Rapier
acquisition: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

name: Rosus' Axe
acquisition: An Axe found in the room sealed by the Imp Statue in the Black Knife Catacombs.

name: Rotten Battle Hammer
acquisition: Warhammer. Guaranteed drop from the Rotten Duelist enemy in the area

name: Rotten Crystal Spear
acquisition: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. Though festering with scarlet rot, its magic remains potent.

name: Rotten Crystal Staff
acquisition: Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

name: Rotten Crystal Sword
acquisition: Straight Sword . Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians . From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

name: Rotten Greataxe
acquisition: Colossal Weapon. Dropped by the duelist enemy guarding the rear of Ordina, Liturgical Town

name: Rotten Staff
acquisition: Colossal Weapon . Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the ring walkway in the east.

name: Royal Greatsword
acquisition: Obtainable at the end of Ranni's questline; Blaidd will spawn in front of Ranni's Rise tower. Best him in combat for a final time to obtain this weapon along with his armor set.

name: Ruins Greatsword
acquisition: Acquired by defeating the Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo bosses at Redmane Castle

name: Rusted Anchor
acquisition: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel .

name: Sacred Relic Sword
acquisition: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.  Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think of it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

name: Sacrificial Axe
acquisition: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)

name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
acquisition: Found in Mt. Gelmir , on a corpse near a Grafted Scion across a stone pillar-bridge northwest of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace. The corpse closest to the ladder has the blade.

name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
acquisition: Dropped together with the All-Knowing Set upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital .

name: Scimitar
acquisition: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

name: Scorpion's Stinger
acquisition: Dagger . Found in a chest to the very west of the Grand Cloister .

name: Scythe
acquisition: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

name: Sentry's Torch
acquisition: Torch Given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

name: Serpent Bow
acquisition: Found by a pool of rot within Abandoned Cave

name: Serpent Flail
acquisition: Head down using the ladder past the first tower, and defeat the enemies. Beware of the flamethrowers. Use spells or arrows if you have them. Reach the end of the area to find a chest that contains this item

name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
acquisition: Can be found at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, after the first singing bat go up two ladders then another one on the left and walk across to where the Land Octopus are

name: Serpent-Hunter
acquisition: Great Spear . Held by a corpse on the left as you enter the boss chamber of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy . This weapon has a special interaction when fighting Rykard in both his first phase as the God-Devouring Serpent and second phase as Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

name: Serpentbone Blade
acquisition: Katana . Rewarded by Tanith after completing the second letter quest.

name: Shamshir
acquisition: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.

name: Short Spear
acquisition: A exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

name: Short Sword
acquisition: A short straight sword with a short blade.  In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.  Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

name: Shortbow
acquisition: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

name: Shotel
acquisition: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.  Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield efficiently.

name: Siluria's Tree
acquisition: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria

name: Smithscript Axe
acquisition: Location: Taylew's Ruined Forge . From the initial site of grace, continue following the path, get past the enemy, and take the ladder down then jump across the other platforms and turn left. You will find a Golem there. Behind it, at the back of the room, you will find the Smithscript Axe.

name: Smithscript Cirque
acquisition: The weapon is looted from a body in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The body is located by the edge of the sewage waterfall.

name: Smithscript Dagger
acquisition: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Take the first ladder down, past the golem, and after the fire blob turn right. As soon as you enter the room past the Fire Blob, slightly to the left. You can also drop down to this area from the lever's location. At the end of the hallway, you will find a golem and this weapon on a corpse near the back wall.

name: Smithscript Greathammer
acquisition: Use the giant platform in the middle to jump to the other side. Once there, keep moving forward and on the left side there will be a fire blob enemy protecting the item. Defeat the enemy and loot the corpse behind it to obtain the weapon.

name: Smithscript Spear
acquisition: The weapon is looted from a body located on the main floor of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

name: Soldier's Crossbow
acquisition: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

name: Spear
acquisition: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

name: Spiked Caestus
acquisition: A Caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fists weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will it to both hands.

name: Spiked Club
acquisition: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

name: Spiked Spear
acquisition: Chance for it to drop from a Marionette Soldier enemy just outside of Witchbane Ruins .

name: Spiraltree Seal
acquisition: Reward for completing "The Sacred Tower" Painting Puzzle .

name: Spirit Glaive
acquisition: Charro's Hidden Grave: This Halberd Can be found on a corpse surrounded by gravestones in the northeastern edges of the area.

name: Spirit Sword
acquisition: Cerulean Coast: Located on a corpse lying next to some gravestones guarded by demi-humans. You can access this area by following the path East from Cerulean Coast West

name: Spread Crossbow
acquisition: A Spread Crossbow can be found on a body by the riverside and the Ellac Greatbridge. Past the Ellac Greatbridge turn right and head to the lower level. There is a smaller camp with three Messmer Soldiers. There you will find the Spread Crossbow.

name: St. Trina's Torch
acquisition: Special Torch. Looted from the treasure chest in the caravan wagon carted in the southern portion of Consecrated Ground in the northern lands.

name: Staff of Loss
acquisition: Glintstone Staff. Found on a corpse leaning over a building's balcony. Accessible by jumping across the rooftops.

name: Staff of the Avatar
acquisition: Drops from the Erdtree Avatar you encounter near the Great Waterfall Crest site of grace. To reach the area, you have to defeat the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss then lie down on the coffin at the back

name: Staff of the Guilty
acquisition: A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glinstone. Similar to hex magic. Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when weilding this staff which enhances Thorn sorceries in particular.

name: Star Fist
acquisition: In the left side of a castle situated atop the mountain near the West Capital Rampart grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital .

name: Star-Lined Sword
acquisition: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in Cerulean Coast's Demi-Human Valley.

name: Starscourge Greatsword
acquisition: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in this youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest up these blades.

name: Steel-Wire Torch
acquisition: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

name: Stone Club
acquisition: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone.  This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
acquisition: This is one of the three altars that affect the Stone-Sheathed Sword. The first one gives you the sword, then you may get the Sword of Darkness or the Sword of Light. Raise the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the light or darkness at this altar to unlock the Sword of Light or Sword of Darkness

name: Stormhawk Axe
acquisition: 2x Found under the bridge leading from the swamp up to Village of the Albinaurics if Nepheli Leux has died.

name: Swift Spear
acquisition: The Swift Spear can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the road

name: Sword of Milos
acquisition: Greatsword . Dropped by Dung Eater as an NPC invader upon defeat.

name: Sword of Night
acquisition: Jolan is a Knight of Night that serves Count Ymir. After completing Ymir's questline, give Jolan the Iris of Occultation to receive the Sword of Night , or the Iris of Grace to receive Swordhand of Night Jolan Spirit Ashes

name: Sword of Night and Flame
acquisition: Straight Sword. Found in a chest inside a locked room behind the gardens. This is accessible by using the walkways above. You can get onto the walkways from the Chapel building in the west.

name: Sword of St. Trina
acquisition: Found inside a chest in the underground cellar of the Forsaken Ruins .

name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
acquisition: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.-

name: Thorned Whip
acquisition: Hefty whip coverd in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of fin.  Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

name: Tooth Whip
acquisition: Found inside the Whipping Hut.

name: Torch
acquisition: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.

name: Torchpole
acquisition: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

name: Treespear
acquisition: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

name: Troll Knight's Sword
acquisition: Colossal Sword. Dropped by a Troll Knight guarding the staircase leading up to the boss of Caria Manor.

name: Troll's Golden Sword
acquisition: In a Chest on a Black Carriage, which can be found east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace.

name: Troll's Hammer
acquisition: Hammer Weapon. Found in a storage shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon.

name: Twinblade
acquisition: Underground. Can be found once you take the stairs down Dragon-Burnt Ruins .

name: Twinned Knight Swords
acquisition: In a burning corpse pile in front of East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau .

name: Uchigatana
acquisition: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.

name: Urumi
acquisition: Whip. Found on a body on the south-east ramparts, reached by jumping from the higher ramparts leading to the elevator and the Manor Upper Level site of grace.

name: Varré's Bouquet
acquisition: Obtained from White-Faced Varre after invading him and depleting his dialogue.

name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
acquisition: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. The sword is in a small cave network there and guarded by several putrescent oozes.

name: Venomous Fang
acquisition: Claw Weapons. Climb on the Iron Maidens near the end of the Abandoned Cave to acquire them.

name: Veteran's Prosthesis
acquisition: Fist Weapon. Dropped by Commander Niall upon defeat.

name: Vulgar Militia Saw
acquisition: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
acquisition: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world

name: Vyke's War Spear
acquisition: Can be dropped from Festering Fingerprint Vyke

name: Wakizashi
acquisition: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave

name: Warhawk's Talon
acquisition: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of the Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

name: Warped Axe
acquisition: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

name: Warpick
acquisition: Looted from one of the many Undead Soldiers .

name: Watchdog's Greatsword
acquisition: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

name: Watchdog's Staff
acquisition: Located in Road's End Catacombs , behind an illusory wall near the stairs at the beginning of the dungeon.

name: Weathered Straight Sword
acquisition: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

name: Whip
acquisition: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.

name: Wing of Astel
acquisition: Curved Sword . Found in a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins . Inaccessible until entering from the Northern, higher level section.

name: Winged Greathorn
acquisition: A unique horn in which the power of ancestral spirit fiercly dwells, this large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as weapon of spirit worship.  In the ancestral spirit-woshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

name: Winged Scythe
acquisition: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins , there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

name: Zamor Curved Sword
acquisition: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave upon defeat.

name: Zweihander
acquisition: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

name: Black Whetblade
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse slumped in front of an altar in Night's Sacred Ground .

name: Glintstone Whetblade
acquisition: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

name: Iron Whetblade
acquisition: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

name: Red-Hot Whetblade
